records.definition_zh: 膝關節內、周圍或牽連小腿、大腿的疼痛，可伴腫脹、活動受限或積液。是主訴而非診斷——同一個膝痛可以是退化性關節炎、韌帶或半月板損傷、痛風、類風濕性關節炎，也可以是中醫的痺症、筋傷。
records.definition_en: Pain in, around, or referred from the knee joint, sometimes with swelling, restricted motion, or effusion. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same knee pain can sit under osteoarthritis, ligament or meniscal injury, gout, rheumatoid arthritis, or the TCM Bi-syndrome and sinew injury categories.
records.patient_words_zh: 「上下樓梯特別痛」「蹲不下去」「膝蓋卡卡的」「腫得像饅頭」「走久了就沒力」「天氣變化前就先痛」
records.patient_words_en: "Stairs are the worst", "I can't squat down", "my knee catches/locks", "it's swollen like a bun", "my leg gives out after walking a while", "it aches before the weather changes"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 腫痛重著屬濕痺 · 刺痛拒按屬瘀 · 隱痛痠軟屬肝腎虧虛 · 灼痛紅腫屬熱痺

inquiry_zh.why: 膝內側、外側、髕骨前、膕窩各指向不同結構性病因
腫脹重著、刺痛固定、隱痛痠軟、紅腫灼熱分屬四類病機
外傷、久蹲久跪、負重運動、天氣濕冷、年齡退化
休息是否減輕、熱敷是否舒緩、活動後是否反而加重
腫脹積液、關節絞鎖、發熱紅腫、全身多關節受累提示不同方向
急性外傷與慢性反覆退化處置完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Medial, lateral, anterior/patellar, or popliteal each points to a different structural cause
Swollen and heavy, fixed stabbing, dull and achy, or hot and red map to four different mechanisms
Trauma, prolonged squatting or kneeling, load-bearing exercise, cold-damp weather, age-related degeneration
Whether rest helps, whether heat soothes it, or whether it paradoxically worsens with activity
Effusion, locking, fever with redness, or involvement of multiple joints each point a different way
An acute injury and a slow degenerative course are managed completely differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 腫脹重著，遇陰雨加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 膝部腫脹重著，屈伸不利，遇陰雨寒濕天氣加重，得溫稍舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 紅腫灼熱疼痛，拒按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 關節紅腫灼熱，疼痛拒按，可伴發熱，多見於痛風急性發作或感染性關節炎

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱痛痠軟，勞累加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 膝部隱隱痠痛，勞則加重，休息減輕，兼腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴，多見於退化性關節炎或久病老年

differentiation_zh.variant: 刺痛固定，外傷或久病史
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定不移，拒按，夜間痛甚，多有外傷或關節損傷病史

differentiation_en.variant: Swollen and heavy, worse in damp weather
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Swollen, heavy knee with restricted flexion/extension, worse in cold-damp weather, slightly better for warmth

differentiation_en.variant: Hot, red, worse for pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Red, swollen, hot joint, tender to pressure, may have fever — typical of acute gout flare or septic/inflammatory arthritis

differentiation_en.variant: Dull aching, worse with exertion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague chronic ache worse with exertion and better with rest, with weak aching low back and knees, dizziness and tinnitus — typical of degenerative joint disease or older patients

differentiation_en.variant: Fixed stabbing pain, injury history
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed unmoving pain, tender to pressure, worse at night, usually with a trauma or joint injury history

red_flags_zh: 關節紅腫熱痛合併發熱 → 排除化膿性關節炎，需緊急處置
重大外傷後無法負重、明顯畸形或神經血管徵象異常 → 需立即影像與骨科評估
膝部腫脹合併全身多關節受累、晨僵超過一小時 → 提示發炎性關節炎（如類風濕性關節炎），需轉診
red_flags_en: Hot, red, swollen joint with fever → rule out septic arthritis, urgent treatment needed
Inability to bear weight, visible deformity, or abnormal neurovascular signs after major trauma → immediate imaging and orthopedic assessment
Knee swelling with involvement of multiple other joints and morning stiffness over an hour → suggests inflammatory arthritis (e.g. rheumatoid arthritis), refer for assessment
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 肌肉突然不自主、強烈收縮，多見於小腿腓腸肌，常在夜間或運動後發作，可觸及硬塊，數秒至數分鐘後緩解。與持續性肌張力異常（如痙攣、僵直）不同——抽筋是陣發性的。
records.definition_en: A sudden, involuntary, strongly painful muscle contraction, most often in the calf, commonly at night or after exercise, palpable as a hard knot, resolving over seconds to minutes. Distinct from sustained tone abnormalities such as spasticity or rigidity — a cramp is paroxysmal.
records.patient_words_zh: 「半夜小腿突然抽起來，痛到跳起來」「肌肉整個縮成一塊，硬邦邦的」「運動完就開始抽」「一抽筋要按摩很久才鬆開」
records.patient_words_en: "My calf seizes up in the middle of the night and I jump out of bed", "the muscle balls up hard", "it starts right after I exercise", "it takes ages of rubbing before it lets go"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 冷痛拘急屬寒凝 · 抽掣痠軟屬血虛不榮筋 · 掣痛兼煩熱屬陰虛

inquiry_zh.why: 小腿腓腸肌最常見；足底、大腿、手部抽筋指向不同誘因
夜間發作多屬血虛、腎虛；運動後即發多屬津液耗傷
運動出汗、懷孕、久站、脫水、利尿劑或某些藥物、寒冷刺激
按摩伸展是否可解、熱敷是否有效
肢冷畏寒、口乾煩熱、肌肉無力持續、單側腫脹疼痛提示不同方向
偶發與頻繁反覆的處置與檢查方向不同

inquiry_en.why: The calf is most common; foot, thigh, or hand cramps point to different triggers
Nocturnal cramps often signal blood or Kidney deficiency; cramps right after exercise suggest fluid loss
Exercise and sweating, pregnancy, prolonged standing, dehydration, diuretics or certain medications, cold exposure
Whether massage or stretching resolves it, whether heat helps
Cold limbs and cold aversion, dry mouth with vexing heat, persistent muscle weakness, or one-sided swelling and pain each point a different way
Occasional versus frequent recurrent cramping changes both workup and management

differentiation_zh.variant: 冷痛拘急，畏寒肢冷
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 抽筋遇寒加重，得溫則緩，兼畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠冷

differentiation_zh.variant: 夜間抽筋，爪甲不榮，面色淡白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 夜間或休息時抽筋，兼頭暈眼花、爪甲不榮、面色淡白，屬血虛不能榮養筋脈

differentiation_zh.variant: 抽筋伴口乾咽燥，運動後汗出多
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 運動或出汗後抽筋，兼口乾咽燥、五心煩熱，屬陰虛津傷、筋脈失濡

differentiation_en.variant: Cold, gripping pain with cold aversion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramp worse in cold, better for warmth, with cold aversion and cold aching low back and knees

differentiation_en.variant: Nocturnal cramping, poor nails, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramps at night or at rest, with dizziness, blurred vision, poorly nourished nails and a pale complexion — Blood too deficient to nourish the sinews

differentiation_en.variant: Cramping with dry mouth, heavy sweating after exercise
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cramps after exercise or sweating, with dry mouth and throat and vexing heat in the five centers — Yin and fluids depleted, sinews under-nourished

red_flags_zh: 抽筋部位明顯單側腫脹、皮溫升高、壓痛 → 排除深層靜脈栓塞
抽筋伴進行性肌肉無力、運動後茶色尿 → 排除橫紋肌溶解症，需緊急就醫
抽筋伴單側肢體無力、言語或視覺改變 → 排除中風
red_flags_en: Marked one-sided swelling, warmth, and tenderness at the cramp site → rule out deep vein thrombosis
Cramping with progressive muscle weakness and tea-colored urine after exertion → rule out rhabdomyolysis, urgent care needed
Cramping with one-sided limb weakness, speech, or vision change → rule out stroke
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）；CDC stroke signs and symptoms

records.definition_zh: 自覺呼吸費力、喘不過氣或需要更用力才能吸到足夠空氣的主觀感受，可在靜止或活動時出現。是主訴而非診斷——同一個氣短可以是心臟、肺臟、貧血、焦慮或中醫的肺脾腎氣虛、痰飲。
records.definition_en: The subjective sense of effortful breathing, air hunger, or needing to work harder to get enough air, at rest or on exertion. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same breathlessness can sit under cardiac, pulmonary, anemic, or anxiety-related causes, or the TCM categories of Lung/Spleen/Kidney Qi deficiency and phlegm-rheum.
records.patient_words_zh: 「爬個樓梯就喘」「胸口悶悶的吸不飽」「講話講到一半要換氣」「躺平就喘不過氣」「一動就上氣不接下氣」
records.patient_words_en: "A flight of stairs and I'm gasping", "my chest feels tight, I can't get a full breath", "I have to stop mid-sentence to breathe", "I can't breathe lying flat", "the moment I move I'm out of breath"

location.why: 全身性呼吸症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 動則氣短屬氣虛 · 夜間平臥加重提示心衰竭需紅旗評估

inquiry_zh.why: 活動後、靜止時、平躺後各指向不同機轉——心因性常平躺加重，氣虛則動輒喘
夜間陣發性呼吸困難是心衰竭的關鍵警訊；晨起明顯提示肺氣虛
坐起是否緩解、休息是否恢復、用藥（吸入劑）反應
胸痛、心悸、下肢腫、咳痰、發熱、體重變化——紅旗多掛在這一問上
急性驟發與慢性漸進的鑑別方向與急迫程度完全不同

inquiry_en.why: With exertion, at rest, or lying flat each points to a different mechanism — cardiac causes often worsen lying flat, Qi deficiency worsens with any exertion
Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea is a key warning sign for heart failure; prominent on waking suggests Lung Qi deficiency
Whether sitting up helps, whether rest restores normal breathing, response to inhaler medication
Chest pain, palpitations, leg swelling, cough with sputum, fever, weight change — most red flags hang off this question
Sudden acute onset versus slow chronic progression differ completely in both differential and urgency

differentiation_zh.variant: 動則氣短，自汗易感
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 稍動即氣短，語聲低怯，自汗，易感冒，兼倦怠乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 喘促痰多黏稠色黃
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 喘促胸悶，咳痰黃稠量多，兼身熱口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 呼多吸少，動則喘甚，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 呼氣多吸氣少，動則喘息尤甚，兼腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷，屬腎不納氣

differentiation_zh.variant: 胸悶氣短，痰多苔膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胸悶氣短，咳痰量多色白易咯，兼身重納呆

differentiation_en.variant: Breathless on exertion, spontaneous sweating, easily catches colds
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless with the least exertion, weak low voice, spontaneous sweating, catches colds easily, with fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Wheezy breathlessness with thick yellow sputum
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless with chest fullness, copious thick yellow sputum, with body heat and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: More breathing out than in, worse with exertion, weak aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficulty inhaling relative to exhaling, markedly worse with exertion, with weak aching low back and knees and cold aversion — Kidney failing to grasp Qi

differentiation_en.variant: Chest fullness and breathlessness, copious sputum, greasy coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Chest fullness and breathlessness, copious white sputum that comes up easily, with heavy limbs and poor appetite

red_flags_zh: 突發或嚴重呼吸困難、發紺、無法平躺或講不出完整句子 → 屬急診等級
呼吸困難合併胸痛、意識改變 → 立即就醫評估
夜間陣發性呼吸困難、端坐呼吸、下肢腫 → 排除心衰竭
red_flags_en: Sudden or severe breathing difficulty, cyanosis, inability to lie flat, or inability to speak in full sentences → emergency-level
Breathing difficulty with chest pain or altered mental status → immediate medical evaluation
Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, orthopnea, and leg swelling → rule out heart failure
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 氣道受刺激引發的反射性呼氣動作，可乾咳無痰或咳吐痰液。病人描述性質、痰色、誘因與病程，醫者在診間也能直接聽到咳嗽聲——這是本症同時具備自述與他覺兩種取得型態的原因。
records.definition_en: A reflex expiratory act triggered by airway irritation, dry or productive of sputum. The patient describes the character, sputum color, triggers and course; the examiner also hears the cough directly during the visit — which is why this symptom genuinely carries both observation modes.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直乾咳，喉嚨癢癢的」「咳到有痰，黃黃稠稠的」「一躺下就咳」「咳到胸口痛」「講話講久就咳」
records.patient_words_en: "I keep dry-coughing, my throat is itchy", "I cough up thick yellow phlegm", "I cough the moment I lie down", "it hurts my chest to cough", "talking for a while sets it off"

location.why: 全身性呼吸道症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 晨起咳痰多屬痰濕 · 夜間乾咳屬陰虛 · 遇風即咳屬肺氣虛易感

inquiry_zh.why: 乾咳無痰、咳痰稀白、咳痰黃稠分屬不同病機，是問診第一問
晨起、夜間、遇風遇冷發作各有指向
感冒、過敏原、冷空氣、進食、平躺、情緒
服藥反應、飲水或潤喉是否緩解
咯血、胸痛、發熱、體重下降、呼吸困難——紅旗都掛在這一問
急性（多屬外感）與慢性（超過八週，需另查病因）處置完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Dry cough, thin white sputum, or thick yellow sputum map to different mechanisms — the first question to ask
Worse on waking, at night, or triggered by wind/cold each point somewhere different
Colds, allergens, cold air, eating, lying flat, emotion
Response to medication, whether fluids or throat soothers help
Hemoptysis, chest pain, fever, weight loss, breathlessness — most red flags hang off this question
Acute (usually external contraction) versus chronic (over eight weeks, needs further workup) are managed completely differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 咳嗽痰稀色白，惡寒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咳嗽聲重，痰稀色白，兼鼻塞流清涕、惡寒無汗，多見於外感初起

differentiation_zh.variant: 咳嗽痰黃質稠，咽痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咳嗽氣粗，痰黃質稠，兼咽痛、發熱口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 乾咳少痰，口燥咽乾
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 乾咳無痰或痰少而黏，久咳不癒，兼口燥咽乾、午後顴紅、手足心熱

differentiation_zh.variant: 咳痰量多色白易咯
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咳嗽反覆，痰多色白質稀或稠而易咯出，兼胸悶納呆、身重

differentiation_en.variant: Thin white sputum, aversion to cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy-sounding cough with thin white sputum, nasal congestion with clear discharge, cold aversion without sweating — typical of early external contraction

differentiation_en.variant: Thick yellow sputum, sore throat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Coarse cough with thick yellow sputum, sore throat, fever and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: Dry cough, scant sputum, dry mouth and throat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dry or scant sticky sputum, cough that lingers, with dry mouth and throat, afternoon flushed cheeks and warm palms/soles

differentiation_en.variant: Copious white sputum, comes up easily
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Recurring cough with copious thin-or-thick white sputum that comes up easily, with chest fullness, poor appetite and heavy limbs

red_flags_zh: 咯血 → 需醫療評估排除肺結核、肺癌、肺栓塞等
咳嗽合併嚴重呼吸困難、發紺或胸痛 → 屬急診等級
持續高熱不退合併咳嗽 → 排除肺炎
red_flags_en: Hemoptysis → needs medical evaluation to rule out tuberculosis, lung cancer, pulmonary embolism, and similar causes
Cough with severe breathing difficulty, cyanosis, or chest pain → emergency-level
Persistent high fever with cough → rule out pneumonia
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 腹部（劍突下至恥骨聯合之間任何區域）的疼痛，範圍廣泛，可為瀰漫性或局限於某一象限。是主訴而非診斷——同一個腹痛可以出現在急腹症、腸胃炎、腸躁症，也可以是中醫的肝鬱、寒凝、食積、血瘀。
records.definition_en: Pain anywhere between the xiphoid process and the pubic symphysis, diffuse or localized to a quadrant. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same abdominal pain can sit under an acute abdomen, gastroenteritis, irritable bowel syndrome, or the TCM categories of Liver Qi stagnation, cold stagnation, food accumulation, or Blood stasis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「肚子一陣一陣絞痛」「悶悶脹脹的，說不出哪裡最痛」「按下去反而更痛」「冷到就痛」「吃完就痛」
records.patient_words_en: "It comes in waves, like cramping", "a dull fullness, I can't point to exactly where", "pressing makes it worse", "it hurts when I get cold", "it hurts right after eating"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹痛竄痛屬氣滯 · 冷痛喜溫屬寒 · 刺痛拒按屬血瘀 · 隱痛喜按屬虛

inquiry_zh.why: 上腹、下腹、單側、瀰漫各指向不同臟腑與結構
脹痛竄痛、冷痛、刺痛、隱痛分屬四類病機
飲食生冷、情緒、進食、月經週期
按之減輕屬虛、拒按屬實、得溫則減屬寒、排便排氣後是否緩解
發熱、嘔吐、腹瀉、便秘、血便、腹肌僵硬——紅旗多掛在這一問上
突發劇痛與慢性反覆的緊急程度完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Upper, lower, one-sided, or diffuse each implicates different organs and structures
Distending/wandering pain, cold pain, stabbing pain, or dull pain map to four different mechanisms
Cold or raw food, emotion, eating, menstrual cycle
Better for pressure = deficiency, worse for pressure = excess, better for warmth = cold, whether passing stool or gas helps
Fever, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, blood in stool, rigid abdomen — most red flags hang off this question
Sudden severe pain versus chronic recurrent pain differ enormously in urgency

differentiation_zh.variant: 脹痛竄痛，情緒波動誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腹痛脹滿，攻竄不定，隨情緒波動而增減，噯氣或矢氣後稍舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 冷痛喜溫喜按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 腹部隱隱冷痛，喜溫喜按，得食或熱敷則減，兼畏寒肢冷、便溏

differentiation_zh.variant: 刺痛拒按，固定不移
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定，刺痛拒按，夜間痛甚，多有外傷或婦科病史

differentiation_zh.variant: 脹痛拒按，噯腐吞酸
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脘腹脹痛拒按，噯氣酸腐，便後或矢氣後脹痛稍減，多因飲食過量

differentiation_en.variant: Distending, wandering pain, worse with emotion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending, wandering abdominal pain that rises and falls with mood, slightly relieved by belching or passing gas

differentiation_en.variant: Cold, dull pain, better for warmth and pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague cold ache in the abdomen, better with warmth and pressure, relieved by eating or a heat pack, with cold aversion and loose stool

differentiation_en.variant: Fixed stabbing pain, worse for pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed pain, stabbing and tender to pressure, worse at night, often with a trauma or gynecologic history

differentiation_en.variant: Distending pain worse for pressure, sour belching
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Epigastric/abdominal distension tender to pressure, sour foul belching, slightly relieved after passing stool or gas, usually from overeating

red_flags_zh: 突發劇烈腹痛、腹部僵硬拒按 → 排除急腹症（如穿孔、闌尾炎）
腹痛合併消化道出血、暈厥 → 需緊急就醫
懷孕中出現劇烈腹痛合併陰道出血 → 排除子宮外孕或流產
腹痛合併持續嘔吐、無法進食進水 → 需醫療評估脫水與阻塞
red_flags_en: Sudden severe abdominal pain with a rigid, guarded abdomen → rule out an acute abdomen (perforation, appendicitis, etc.)
Abdominal pain with GI bleeding or syncope → urgent medical evaluation
Severe abdominal pain with vaginal bleeding during pregnancy → rule out ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage
Abdominal pain with persistent vomiting and inability to keep down fluids → medical evaluation for dehydration and obstruction
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 劍突下、上腹正中偏胃脘部位的疼痛，範圍較腹痛更侷限。是主訴而非診斷——同一個胃脘痛可以是消化性潰瘍、功能性消化不良、膽胰疾病，也可以是中醫的肝胃不和、胃熱、脾胃虛寒。
records.definition_en: Pain localized to the epigastrium, below the xiphoid process, more circumscribed than general abdominal pain. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same epigastric pain can sit under peptic ulcer disease, functional dyspepsia, or biliary/pancreatic disease, or the TCM categories of Liver-Stomach disharmony, Stomach heat, or Spleen-Stomach yang deficiency.
records.patient_words_zh: 「胃這裡一直悶痛」「吃完就脹痛」「空腹時特別痛，吃點東西就好一點」「一生氣胃就開始痛」「胃裡火燒火燎的」
records.patient_words_en: "There's a constant dull ache right here in my stomach", "it aches and bloats right after eating", "it's worse on an empty stomach, eating a little helps", "my stomach starts hurting whenever I'm upset", "a burning feeling in my stomach"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹痛連脅屬肝胃不和 · 灼痛屬胃熱 · 隱痛喜按屬脾胃虛寒 · 刺痛拒按屬血瘀

inquiry_zh.why: 脹痛、灼痛、隱痛、刺痛分屬四類病機，是本症辨證最有重量的一問
空腹痛、食後痛與潰瘍位置及虛實有關
情緒、飲食生冷辛辣、飲酒、服用 NSAID 類藥物
進食是否緩解、按壓是否舒服、制酸劑反應
噯氣泛酸、嘔血黑便、體重下降、吞嚥困難——紅旗都掛在這一問
新發與反覆多年的評估方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Distending, burning, dull, or stabbing pain map to four different mechanisms — the highest-yield question here
Pain on an empty stomach versus after eating relates to ulcer location and to deficiency/excess
Emotion, cold or spicy food, alcohol, NSAID use
Whether eating relieves it, whether pressure feels good, response to antacids
Belching, acid regurgitation, hematemesis, black stool, weight loss, dysphagia — most red flags hang off this question
New onset versus years of recurrence point toward different workups

differentiation_zh.variant: 脹痛連脅，噯氣頻作
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘脹痛，連及兩脅，噯氣則舒，隨情緒波動而增減

differentiation_zh.variant: 灼痛，嘈雜泛酸，口苦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘灼痛，嘈雜易饑，泛酸口苦，口渴喜冷飲

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱痛喜按，食後脹，倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘隱隱作痛，喜溫喜按，食後脹滿，兼倦怠乏力、食少便溏

differentiation_zh.variant: 刺痛拒按，痛處固定
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘刺痛，痛處固定拒按，夜間尤甚，久病或有黑便病史

differentiation_en.variant: Distending pain into the flanks, frequent belching
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending epigastric pain radiating to both flanks, relieved by belching, rising and falling with mood

differentiation_en.variant: Burning pain, gnawing hunger, acid reflux, bitter taste
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Burning epigastric pain, gnawing hunger, acid regurgitation, bitter taste, thirst for cold drinks

differentiation_en.variant: Dull pain, better for pressure, bloating after eating, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague epigastric ache, better with warmth and pressure, bloating after eating, with fatigue, poor appetite and loose stool

differentiation_en.variant: Fixed stabbing pain, worse for pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Stabbing epigastric pain, fixed and tender to pressure, worse at night, usually long-standing or with a history of black stool

red_flags_zh: 劇烈突發胃脘痛合併腹部僵硬拒按 → 排除消化性潰瘍穿孔
胃脘痛合併吐血、解黑便或暈厥 → 排除消化道出血，需緊急就醫
胸悶壓迫感樣胃脘痛合併冒冷汗、放射至左臂或下顎 → 排除心臟疾病
持續嘔吐、進行性體重下降或吞嚥困難 → 需進一步檢查排除惡性病變
red_flags_en: Sudden severe epigastric pain with a rigid, guarded abdomen → rule out perforated peptic ulcer
Epigastric pain with hematemesis, black stool, or syncope → rule out GI bleeding, urgent care needed
Chest-pressure-like epigastric pain with cold sweats, radiating to the left arm or jaw → rule out cardiac disease
Persistent vomiting, progressive weight loss, or dysphagia → further workup to rule out malignancy
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.pinyin: wei shi dao ni liu zheng zhuang
records.pinyin_toned: wèi shí dào nì liú zhèng zhuàng
records.definition_zh: 胃內容物或酸液上湧引起的胸骨後或上腹灼熱不適感，重點在「灼熱」這個性質本身——與 sym.regurgitation（反酸，內容物確實湧到咽喉口腔）是同一機轉下兩個不同的觀察點：一個是感覺，一個是物質上湧的事實。
records.definition_en: A retrosternal or epigastric burning discomfort caused by stomach contents or acid rising upward, with the emphasis on the burning quality itself — a distinct observation point from sym.regurgitation (the actual rising of material into the throat/mouth), even though both arise from the same underlying mechanism.
records.patient_words_zh: 「胸口像火在燒」「吃完飯就火燒心」「躺下去更嚴重」「喉嚨後面酸酸熱熱的」
records.patient_words_en: "It's like a fire in my chest", "heartburn right after eating", "it's worse lying down", "a sour, hot feeling at the back of my throat"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，「灼熱感」雖近似「灼」但本症核心是逆流感而非疼痛性質分類，不強行套用

laterality.why: 正中食道／胃部症狀，無側性

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 食後與平躺加重是本症最典型的時間模式

inquiry_zh.why: 食後、平躺、夜間加重是本症最典型的時間模式，也是問診第一問
辛辣油膩飲食、飲酒、咖啡、情緒、肥胖、懷孕
抬高床頭、避免睡前進食、制酸劑反應
吞嚥困難、吞嚥疼痛、體重下降、胸痛——紅旗都掛在這一問
偶發與每週多次的長期反覆，處置積極程度不同

inquiry_en.why: Worse after eating, lying flat, or at night is the classic pattern here — the first question to ask
Spicy or fatty food, alcohol, coffee, emotion, obesity, pregnancy
Raising the head of the bed, avoiding food before sleep, response to antacids
Dysphagia, odynophagia, weight loss, chest pain — most red flags hang off this question
Occasional versus several-times-weekly chronic recurrence changes how aggressively it is managed

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱隱灼熱，口乾不多飲，倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 灼熱感較輕但纏綿，口乾而不欲多飲，兼胃脘嘈雜、大便偏乾、倦怠

differentiation_en.distinguishing: Pronounced retrosternal burning with a bitter dry mouth and flank fullness, rising and falling with mood

differentiation_en.variant: Burning with epigastric fullness, frequent belching
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Burning with epigastric distension and frequent belching, worse with stress or low mood

differentiation_en.variant: Mild but lingering burning, dry mouth without much thirst, fatigue

red_flags_zh: 吞嚥困難或吞嚥疼痛 → 需進一步檢查排除食道狹窄或惡性病變

records.definition_zh: 胃內容物（酸水或食物殘渣）不自主湧至咽喉或口腔，可帶酸味或無味清水。與 sym.reflux（胸骨後灼熱感）是同一機轉下的另一個觀察點——本症記錄的是「有東西真的湧上來」，不是灼熱的感覺。
records.definition_en: Involuntary rising of stomach contents — sour acid or food residue — into the throat or mouth, sour-tasting or a tasteless watery fluid. A distinct observation point from sym.reflux (retrosternal burning): this card records the fact of material actually rising up, not the burning sensation.
records.patient_words_zh: 「酸水一直湧上來」「嘴巴裡突然一股酸味」「吃下去的東西又跑回喉嚨」「清水一直往上冒」

inquiry_zh.why: 反酸而灼熱、與反清水無味，分屬熱與寒兩個方向
食後、平躺、夜間加重
飲食過量、辛辣油膩、情緒、彎腰負重
少量多餐、避免平躺進食、制酸劑反應

偶發與長期反覆的處置積極程度不同

inquiry_en.why: Sour and burning versus tasteless watery fluid point toward heat and cold respectively
Worse after eating, lying flat, or at night
Overeating, spicy or fatty food, emotion, bending or heavy lifting
Smaller more frequent meals, avoiding lying down after eating, response to antacids
Dysphagia, weight loss, chest pain — most red flags hang off this question

differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sour regurgitation with epigastric and flank fullness, markedly worse with mood swings, slightly relieved by belching

differentiation_en.variant: Sour, burning reflux, bitter mouth, bad breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sour burning regurgitation, bitter taste and bad breath, gnawing hunger, craving cold drinks

differentiation_en.variant: Tasteless watery reflux, better for warmth and pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Regurgitation of clear tasteless fluid, cold epigastric pain better with warmth and pressure, poor appetite, loose stool, cold aversion

records.definition_zh: 胃內氣體經口排出，發出聲響，可頻繁發作或偶發。與 sym.hiccup（呃逆，橫膈膜不自主痙攣）不同——噯氣是胃氣上逆的排氣動作，聲音較長、通常可自主抑制。
records.definition_en: Audible expulsion of gas from the stomach through the mouth, occasional or frequent. Distinct from sym.hiccup (an involuntary diaphragmatic spasm) — belching is a Stomach-Qi ascending release, longer in sound and usually somewhat voluntarily suppressible.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直打嗝，胃裡的氣一直上來」「吃完飯就開始噯氣」「噯氣完會舒服一點」「噯氣有酸腐味」
records.patient_words_en: "I keep burping, gas keeps coming up from my stomach", "it starts right after eating", "belching gives some relief", "the burps taste sour/foul"

location.why: 全身性消化道排氣症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 食後噯氣多屬食積；情緒誘發多屬肝氣犯胃

inquiry_zh.why: 情緒、飲食過量、進食過快、碳酸飲料
食後、情緒波動時發作各有指向
噯氣後是否舒緩、進食清淡是否減少
酸腐味、脘腹脹滿、吞嚥困難、體重下降——紅旗多掛在這一問
偶發與每日頻繁反覆的評估方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Emotion, overeating, eating too quickly, carbonated drinks
After eating or during emotional upset each points somewhere different
Whether belching itself brings relief, whether a lighter diet reduces it
Sour or foul odor, epigastric distension, dysphagia, weight loss — most red flags hang off this question
Occasional versus daily frequent recurrence points toward different workups

differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 噯氣頻作，隨情緒波動增減，兼脘脅脹悶、噯氣後稍舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 噯氣酸腐，食後加重，脘腹脹滿

differentiation_zh.variant: 噯氣無力，食少便溏，倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 噯氣聲低無力，食後易脹但無明顯酸腐味，兼食少便溏、倦怠乏力

differentiation_en.variant: Frequent belching, worse with emotion, radiating to the flanks
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Frequent belching that rises and falls with mood, with epigastric/flank fullness, slightly relieved by belching itself

differentiation_en.variant: Sour/foul belching, worse after eating, epigastric fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Belching with a sour, foul odor, worse after eating, slightly relieved by belching or passing gas, usually from overeating

differentiation_en.variant: Weak belching, poor appetite, loose stool, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low, effortless belching, bloating after eating without a marked sour smell, with poor appetite, loose stool and fatigue

red_flags_zh: 噯氣合併進行性吞嚥困難 → 需進一步檢查排除食道狹窄或惡性病變
噯氣合併消化道出血、明顯體重下降 → 需醫療評估

records.definition_zh: 橫膈膜不自主陣發性痙攣，伴聲門突然關閉發出特有聲響。病人自述發作頻率與誘因，醫者在診間也能直接聽到——這是本症同時具備自述與他覺兩種取得型態的原因。與噯氣不同，呃逆是不自主的、聲音短促。
records.definition_en: Involuntary, paroxysmal spasm of the diaphragm with sudden glottic closure producing the characteristic sound. The patient reports frequency and triggers; the examiner also hears it directly during the visit — which is why this symptom genuinely carries both observation modes. Distinct from belching: hiccups are involuntary and short-sounding.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直打嗝停不下來」「吃太快就開始呃逆」「打嗝打到肚子都痛了」「已經呃逆好幾天了」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't stop hiccupping", "eating too fast sets it off", "hiccups hurt my stomach after a while", "I've had hiccups for days"

location.why: 全身性膈肌反射症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 呃聲洪亮有力屬實（胃熱、氣鬱）· 呃聲低沉無力屬虛（脾胃陽虛）

inquiry_zh.why: 呃聲洪亮有力與低沉無力分屬實證與虛證兩個方向
進食過快、飲食生冷或辛辣、情緒波動、腹部手術後
屏氣、飲水、驚嚇等民間方法是否有效
神經系統症狀、呼吸困難、胸痛、持續嘔吐——紅旗都掛在這一問
短暫發作（多屬生理性或飲食誘發）與持續超過 48 小時（需查病因）處置不同

inquiry_en.why: Loud forceful hiccups versus low weak hiccups point toward excess versus deficiency respectively
Eating too fast, cold or spicy food, emotional upset, post-abdominal surgery
Whether breath-holding, drinking water, or being startled helps
Neurologic symptoms, breathing difficulty, chest pain, persistent vomiting — most red flags hang off this question
A brief episode (usually physiologic or food-triggered) versus persisting over 48 hours (needs a cause worked up) are managed differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 呃聲洪亮有力，口臭便秘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 呃逆聲響有力，兼口臭、口渴喜冷飲、大便秘結

differentiation_zh.variant: 呃逆頻作，情緒誘發，胸脅滿悶
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 呃逆隨情緒波動而發，兼胸脅滿悶、噯氣

differentiation_zh.variant: 呃聲低沉無力，手足不溫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 呃逆聲低沉斷續、氣不接續，兼手足不溫、食少便溏，多見於久病或術後

differentiation_en.variant: Loud forceful hiccups, bad breath, constipation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Loud forceful hiccups with bad breath, thirst for cold drinks, and constipation

differentiation_en.variant: Frequent hiccups triggered by emotion, chest/flank fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hiccups that flare with mood swings, with chest and flank fullness and belching

differentiation_en.variant: Low, weak, intermittent hiccups, cold extremities
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low, weak, broken hiccups with poor breath support, cold hands and feet, poor appetite and loose stool — usually chronic illness or post-surgical

red_flags_zh: 呃逆持續超過 48 小時（頑固性呃逆）→ 需醫療評估病因
呃逆合併神經系統症狀（單側無力、言語或視覺改變）→ 排除中風
呃逆合併呼吸困難、胸痛或持續嘔吐 → 需醫療評估
red_flags_en: Hiccups persisting beyond 48 hours (intractable hiccups) → medical evaluation for underlying cause
Hiccups with neurologic symptoms (one-sided weakness, speech or vision change) → rule out stroke
Hiccups with breathing difficulty, chest pain, or persistent vomiting → medical evaluation

records.definition_zh: 胃內容物經口強力排出的動作，通常先有噁心。與 sym.nausea（噁心，只是想吐的感覺）不同——嘔吐是實際的排出動作，是一個可以描述吐出物性狀、頻率、量的具體事件。
records.definition_en: The forceful oral expulsion of stomach contents, usually preceded by nausea. Distinct from sym.nausea (the sensation of wanting to vomit without expulsion) — vomiting is the actual expulsive event, describable by the character, frequency, and volume of what comes up.
records.patient_words_zh: 「吐得整個人都虛脫了」「一喝水就吐」「吐出來的是黃綠色的」「吐完會舒服一點」「吃什麼吐什麼」
records.patient_words_en: "I'm wiped out from throwing up", "I vomit the moment I drink water", "what comes up is yellow-green", "I feel better after vomiting", "everything I eat comes back up"

location.why: 全身性消化道排出動作，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；嘔吐辨證關鍵在吐出物性狀（酸腐／清水／苦水），該軸不在此詞彙表

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 食後即吐多屬實證；晨起嘔吐提示妊娠或顱內壓增高

inquiry_zh.why: 吐出物是酸腐、清水還是苦水，分屬食積、寒證與肝膽鬱熱三個方向
食後即吐、晨起嘔吐各有不同指向
飲食不潔或過量、暈車暈船、懷孕、藥物、情緒
吐後是否舒緩、少量多次進食是否可耐受
血絲或咖啡渣樣嘔吐物、劇烈頭痛、意識改變、脫水徵象——紅旗都掛在這一問
急性單次與持續反覆的緊急程度與評估方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Sour/foul, clear watery, or bitter vomitus points toward food accumulation, cold patterns, or Liver-Gallbladder heat respectively
Vomiting right after eating versus first thing in the morning each point somewhere different
Contaminated or excessive food, motion sickness, pregnancy, medication, emotion
Whether vomiting itself brings relief, whether small frequent meals are tolerated
Blood-streaked or coffee-ground vomitus, severe headache, altered consciousness, signs of dehydration — most red flags hang off this question
A single acute episode versus ongoing recurrent vomiting differ greatly in urgency and workup

differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 嘔吐物酸腐，脘腹脹滿拒按，吐後脹痛稍減，多因飲食過量

differentiation_zh.variant: 嘔吐清水，畏寒喜溫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 嘔吐清水或食入良久乃吐出，胃脘冷痛喜溫喜按，畏寒肢冷

differentiation_zh.variant: 嘔吐酸苦，情緒誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 嘔吐酸苦，隨情緒波動而作，兼脘脅脹悶、噯氣

differentiation_zh.variant: 嘔吐物臭穢，口渴喜冷
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 嘔吐頻繁，吐物酸臭，口渴喜冷飲，兼口臭便秘

differentiation_en.variant: Sour, foul vomitus, epigastric fullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sour, foul-smelling vomitus, epigastric fullness tender to pressure, slightly relieved after vomiting, usually from overeating

differentiation_en.variant: Clear watery vomitus, cold aversion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vomiting of clear fluid or food eaten long before, cold epigastric pain better with warmth and pressure, cold aversion

differentiation_en.variant: Sour bitter vomitus, triggered by emotion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sour, bitter vomiting that flares with mood, with epigastric/flank fullness and belching

differentiation_en.variant: Foul-smelling vomitus, thirst for cold drinks
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Frequent vomiting with foul-smelling vomitus, thirst for cold drinks, bad breath and constipation

red_flags_zh: 嘔吐物帶血或呈咖啡渣樣 → 排除消化道出血，需緊急就醫
嘔吐合併嚴重脫水徵象、意識改變 → 需緊急處置
嘔吐合併嚴重腹痛或持續不止 → 排除腸阻塞、急腹症

Vomiting with signs of severe dehydration or altered consciousness → urgent treatment needed
Vomiting with severe or persistent abdominal pain → rule out bowel obstruction or acute abdomen
Vomiting with severe headache or neurologic symptoms → rule out raised intracranial pressure

records.definition_zh: 進食少量食物後即感覺胃部已滿，無法繼續進食，與胃排空延遲或胃容受性受損相關。與食慾不振不同——早飽是「開始吃就飽」，不是「根本不想吃」。
records.definition_en: Feeling full after eating only a small amount, unable to continue eating, related to delayed gastric emptying or impaired gastric accommodation. Distinct from poor appetite — early satiety is feeling full soon after starting to eat, not a lack of desire to eat at all.
records.patient_words_zh: 「才吃幾口就飽了」「胃好像縮小了」「吃一點就撐」「沒辦法吃完一餐」
records.patient_words_en: "I'm full after just a few bites", "my stomach feels shrunk", "a little food and I'm stuffed", "I can't finish a meal"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

inquiry_zh.why: 每餐皆如此與近期新發的意義不同
進食速度、食物種類（油膩／固體）、情緒
少量多餐、流質飲食是否較能耐受
體重下降、貧血、噁心嘔吐、腹部腫塊——紅旗都掛在這一問
近期新發需優先排除器質性病變，長年如此多屬功能性

inquiry_en.why: Every meal versus a recent new onset carries different meaning
Speed of eating, food type (fatty/solid), emotion
Whether smaller frequent meals or liquid food is better tolerated
Weight loss, anemia, nausea and vomiting, abdominal mass — most red flags hang off this question
Recent new onset needs organic disease ruled out first; longstanding pattern is usually functional

differentiation_zh.variant: 早飽兼食少便溏，倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 食入即飽，食量明顯減少，兼倦怠乏力、食少便溏、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 早飽脹悶，情緒相關
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 早飽兼脘腹脹悶，隨情緒波動而增減，噯氣則稍舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 早飽兼口乾便乾，形體消瘦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 早飽兼口乾不欲飲、胃脘嘈雜、大便偏乾，久病或形體消瘦

differentiation_en.variant: Early satiety with poor appetite, loose stool, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Full after very little food, markedly reduced intake, with fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool and a sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Early satiety with fullness, related to emotion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Early satiety with epigastric fullness, rising and falling with mood, slightly relieved by belching

differentiation_en.variant: Early satiety with dry mouth, dry stool, thin build
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Early satiety with dry mouth not wanting to drink, gnawing epigastric discomfort, dry stool, chronic illness or thin build

red_flags_zh: 早飽合併進行性體重下降 → 需醫療評估排除惡性病變
早飽合併嘔吐、貧血或消化道出血徵象 → 需進一步檢查
早飽合併可觸及腹部腫塊 → 需影像評估
red_flags_en: Early satiety with progressive weight loss → medical evaluation to rule out malignancy
Early satiety with vomiting, anemia, or signs of GI bleeding → further workup
Early satiety with a palpable abdominal mass → imaging evaluation
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 急迫想排便但排出困難或量少，便後仍有下墜未盡感，反覆想再解。常見於腸道發炎或感染，也是中醫痢疾的典型症狀之一。
records.definition_en: An urgent need to defecate with difficulty passing stool or passing only a small amount, followed by a persistent sense of incomplete evacuation and a recurring urge to go again. Common in intestinal inflammation or infection, and a classic feature of the TCM dysentery category.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直想上廁所，但每次都解不多」「解完還是覺得沒解乾淨」「肛門墜墜的」「一天跑廁所好幾趟，每次都一點點」
records.patient_words_en: "I keep needing to go but barely anything comes out", "I still feel like I haven't finished", "a heavy dragging feeling at the anus", "I run to the bathroom many times a day, just a little each time"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；本症核心是急迫感與墜脹感，不是疼痛性質分類

laterality.why: 直腸肛門正中症狀，無側性

inquiry_zh.why: 膿血便、發熱、腹痛、脫水——紅旗都掛在這一問
飲食不潔、旅遊史、抗生素使用史、發炎性腸道疾病病史
排便後墜脹感是否完全緩解或持續存在
急性（多屬感染性痢疾）與慢性反覆（需查發炎性腸道疾病或腫瘤）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Bloody/mucoid stool, fever, abdominal pain, dehydration — most red flags hang off this question
Contaminated food, travel history, antibiotic use, history of inflammatory bowel disease
Whether the dragging sensation fully resolves after defecation or persists
Acute (usually infectious dysentery) versus chronic recurrent (needs IBD or malignancy worked up) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 里急後重，便下粘凍膿血，肛門灼熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 里急後重明顯，大便粘凍夾膿血，肛門灼熱，兼發熱口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 里急後重反覆，倦怠氣墜
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 里急後重反覆纏綿，便次頻但每次量少，兼倦怠乏力、肛門墜脹感明顯，久病傷正

differentiation_en.variant: Marked tenesmus, mucoid/bloody stool, burning at the anus
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Pronounced tenesmus, mucus and blood in the stool, burning sensation at the anus, with fever and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: Recurring tenesmus, fatigue, dragging sensation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Persistent recurring tenesmus, frequent small-volume stools, with fatigue and a pronounced dragging sensation at the anus — chronic illness depleting the righteous Qi

red_flags_zh: 里急後重合併血便、發熱 → 需醫療評估排除感染性痢疾或發炎性腸道疾病
里急後重合併嚴重腹痛或脫水徵象 → 需緊急處置
持續數週以上的里急後重 → 需進一步檢查排除腫瘤
red_flags_en: Tenesmus with bloody stool and fever → medical evaluation to rule out infectious dysentery or inflammatory bowel disease
Tenesmus with severe abdominal pain or signs of dehydration → urgent treatment needed
Tenesmus persisting more than a few weeks → further workup to rule out malignancy
sources: MedlinePlus bleeding and fever guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 突發強烈、難以延遲的排尿慾望，常合併頻尿，嚴重時可導致急迫性尿失禁。是主訴而非診斷——同一個尿急可以是泌尿道感染、膀胱過動症，也可以是中醫的膀胱濕熱、腎氣不固。
records.definition_en: A sudden, strong, hard-to-defer urge to urinate, often with frequency, and in severe cases urge incontinence. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same urgency can sit under a urinary tract infection or overactive bladder, or the TCM categories of Bladder damp-heat or Kidney Qi not firm.
records.patient_words_zh: 「突然一定要馬上上廁所，忍不住」「一有尿意就要衝廁所」「還沒到廁所就漏了一點」「一天要跑好多次廁所」
records.patient_words_en: "I suddenly have to go right now, I can't hold it", "the moment I feel the urge I have to run", "I leak a little before I make it to the bathroom", "I run to the bathroom many times a day"

location.why: 泌尿系統症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

laterality.why: 膀胱為正中器官，無側性

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 夜尿頻多提示腎氣不固；白天頻繁尿急伴灼熱多屬膀胱濕熱

inquiry_zh.why: 尿痛灼熱、發熱、腰痛、血尿——紅旗與感染指向都掛在這一問
夜尿頻多與白天為主的發作型態指向不同機轉
咖啡因、飲水量、懷孕、停經、憋尿習慣
如廁後是否完全緩解、行為訓練或縮短憋尿時間是否有幫助
急性新發（多需排除感染）與慢性反覆（多屬功能性）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Burning pain on urination, fever, flank pain, hematuria — red flags and infection point mostly hang off this question
Prominent nocturia versus mostly daytime urgency implicate different mechanisms
Caffeine, fluid intake, pregnancy, menopause, habit of holding urine
Whether it fully resolves after voiding, whether bladder training or shorter holding intervals help
New acute onset (usually needs infection ruled out) versus chronic recurrence (usually functional) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 尿急尿痛，尿黃赤灼熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 尿急尿頻，排尿灼熱刺痛，尿色黃赤，兼小腹脹痛

differentiation_zh.variant: 尿急頻多，夜尿明顯，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 尿急頻數，夜尿尤多，兼腰膝痠軟、畏寒，甚則小便失禁

differentiation_en.variant: Urgency with burning pain, dark yellow urine
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Urgency and frequency with burning, stabbing pain on urination, dark yellow urine, and lower abdominal distension

differentiation_en.variant: Frequent urgency, prominent nocturia, weak aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Frequent urgency, especially at night, with weak aching low back and knees, cold aversion, and in severe cases incontinence

red_flags_zh: 尿急合併發熱、腰側疼痛 → 排除腎盂腎炎，需醫療評估
尿急合併明顯血尿 → 需進一步檢查
懷孕期間新發尿急合併發熱 → 需儘速評估
red_flags_en: Urgency with fever and flank pain → rule out pyelonephritis, medical evaluation needed
Urgency with visible hematuria → further workup
New urgency with fever during pregnancy → prompt evaluation needed
sources: MedlinePlus urinary symptoms guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 膀胱內尿液無法順利排出，可為完全無法解尿（急性瀦留）或排尿不盡、餘尿感（慢性瀦留），常伴小腹脹滿。中醫稱「癃閉」，癃者點滴而出、閉者小便不通，程度有輕重之分。
records.definition_en: The inability to fully empty the bladder — complete inability to void (acute retention) or incomplete emptying with a residual sense of fullness (chronic retention), often with lower abdominal fullness. The TCM term Long Bi covers a spectrum from dribbling output (Long) to complete blockage (Bi).
records.patient_words_zh: 「想尿卻尿不出來」「尿完了還覺得沒排乾淨」「小腹一直脹脹的」「尿要等很久才出得來，滴滴答答的」
records.patient_words_en: "I feel the urge but nothing comes out", "I still feel full after going", "my lower belly stays bloated", "it takes forever to start, then just dribbles"

location.why: 泌尿系統症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

laterality.why: 膀胱為正中器官，無側性

inquiry_zh.why: 完全無法解尿與排尿不盡是急迫程度截然不同的兩件事
攝護腺肥大病史、近期手術、藥物（抗膽鹼藥）、神經系統疾病、情緒抑鬱
小腹劇痛脹滿、發熱、下肢麻木無力——紅旗都掛在這一問
突發完全無法解尿是急症；慢性漸進的排尿困難需評估攝護腺或神經病因

inquiry_en.why: Complete inability to void versus incomplete emptying carry very different urgency
History of prostate enlargement, recent surgery, anticholinergic medication, neurologic disease, emotional depression
Severe lower abdominal pain and distension, fever, leg numbness or weakness — most red flags hang off this question
Sudden complete inability to void is an emergency; slow progressive voiding difficulty needs prostate or neurologic causes worked up

differentiation_zh.variant: 小便點滴不通，小腹脹滿拒按，尿黃赤
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 小便點滴而下甚或不通，小腹脹滿拒按，尿黃赤灼熱，兼口苦口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 小便不暢，腰膝痠軟畏寒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 小便滴瀝不暢，排出無力，兼腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷，多見於年長或久病

differentiation_zh.variant: 小便艱澀，隨情緒抑鬱誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 小便不暢或突然不通，多因情緒抑鬱或緊張誘發，兼脅肋脹悶

differentiation_en.variant: Dribbling or complete blockage, lower abdominal distension tender to pressure, dark yellow urine
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Urine dribbling or completely blocked, lower abdomen distended and tender, dark yellow burning urine, with a bitter taste and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: Weak, incomplete voiding, cold aversion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dribbling, weak-stream voiding, with weak aching low back and knees and cold aversion — usually older patients or chronic illness

differentiation_en.variant: Difficult voiding triggered by emotional distress
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Difficult or suddenly blocked voiding, usually triggered by emotional distress or tension, with flank fullness

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus urinary symptoms and emergency guidance
red_flags_zh: 完全無法解尿合併小腹劇痛膀胱脹滿 → 急性尿瀦留，需緊急導尿處置
尿瀦留合併鞍區感覺喪失、下肢無力或大小便失禁 → 排除馬尾症候群，需緊急就醫
尿瀦留合併發熱、腰側疼痛 → 排除感染需醫療評估
red_flags_en: Complete inability to void with severe lower abdominal pain and a distended bladder → acute urinary retention, urgent catheterization needed
Retention with saddle anesthesia, leg weakness, or bowel/bladder incontinence → rule out cauda equina syndrome, urgent care needed
Retention with fever and flank pain → rule out infection, medical evaluation needed
sources: MedlinePlus urinary symptoms and emergency guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 尿液中出現肉眼可見的血液，呈粉紅、鮮紅或茶色，可伴血塊。是主訴而非診斷——同一個血尿可以是泌尿道感染、結石、腫瘤，也可以是中醫的膀胱濕熱、陰虛火旺、脾不統血。
records.definition_en: Visible blood in the urine, pink, bright red, or tea-colored, sometimes with clots. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same hematuria can sit under a urinary tract infection, kidney stones, or malignancy, or the TCM categories of Bladder damp-heat, Yin deficiency with fire, or Spleen failing to govern the Blood.
records.patient_words_zh: 「尿出來是紅色的，嚇了一跳」「小便顏色像洗肉水」「尿裡有血塊」「尿的顏色像濃茶」
records.patient_words_en: "My urine came out red, it scared me", "the color is like rinsed meat water", "there are clots in my urine", "the color is like strong tea"

location.why: 泌尿系統症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 尿血鮮紅屬熱迫血行 · 尿血淡紅屬虛（脾不統血、腎陰虛）

laterality.why: 膀胱為正中器官，無側性

inquiry_zh.why: 鮮紅與淡紅色澤分屬熱證與虛證兩個方向，是本症辨證的重要一問
尿痛、發熱、腰側劇痛、血塊、體重下降、其他部位出血——紅旗都掛在這一問
劇烈運動、抗凝血藥物使用、月經污染（女性需排除）、外傷
單次偶發與反覆出現的評估積極程度不同，尤其無痛性血尿需優先排除腫瘤

inquiry_en.why: Bright red versus pale pink color points toward heat forcing the Blood versus deficiency respectively — an important question here
Pain on urination, fever, severe flank pain, clots, weight loss, bleeding elsewhere — most red flags hang off this question
Strenuous exercise, anticoagulant use, menstrual contamination (rule out in women), trauma
A single episode versus recurrent hematuria differ in how aggressively they are worked up — painless hematuria in particular needs malignancy ruled out first

differentiation_zh.variant: 尿血鮮紅，尿痛灼熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 尿血色鮮紅，排尿灼熱刺痛，尿黃赤，兼小腹脹痛

differentiation_zh.variant: 尿血淡紅，腰膝痠軟，五心煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 尿血色淡紅或間歇出現，無明顯尿痛，兼腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱、頭暈耳鳴

differentiation_zh.variant: 尿血反覆，倦怠氣短，面色萎黃
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 尿血反覆發作，血色淡，兼倦怠乏力、氣短懶言、面色萎黃，屬脾不統血

differentiation_en.variant: Bright red blood, burning pain on urination
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bright red blood in the urine with burning, stabbing pain on urination, dark yellow urine, lower abdominal distension

differentiation_en.variant: Pale pink blood, weak aching low back and knees, vexing heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Pale pink or intermittent hematuria without marked pain, with weak aching low back and knees, vexing heat in the five centers, dizziness and tinnitus

differentiation_en.variant: Recurring hematuria, fatigue, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Recurring hematuria with pale-colored blood, with fatigue, shortness of breath, and a sallow complexion — Spleen failing to govern the Blood

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus urinary symptoms and bleeding guidance
red_flags_zh: 肉眼血尿伴血塊、無法解尿或血流動力學不穩 → 需緊急醫療評估
血尿合併發熱、腰側劇痛 → 排除腎盂腎炎或腎結石併阻塞
無痛性血尿，尤其中老年或吸菸者 → 需優先排除泌尿道腫瘤
red_flags_en: Gross hematuria with clots, inability to void, or hemodynamic instability → urgent medical evaluation
Hematuria with fever and severe flank pain → rule out pyelonephritis or an obstructing kidney stone
Painless hematuria, especially in middle-aged, older, or smoking patients → malignancy must be ruled out first
sources: MedlinePlus urinary symptoms and bleeding guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 突發性、陣發性的全身或上半身熱感，常伴面部潮紅、出汗，數分鐘內緩解，可反覆發作。病人自述發作頻率與程度，醫者在診間也可能直接看到潮紅冒汗的當下——這是本症同時具備自述與他覺兩種取得型態的原因。最常見於更年期，但非女性專屬（甲狀腺機能亢進、藥物、男性睪固酮下降也可出現）。
records.definition_en: A sudden, paroxysmal sensation of heat over the whole body or upper body, often with facial flushing and sweating, resolving within minutes, and recurring. The patient reports frequency and severity; the examiner may also witness the flushing and sweating directly during the visit — which is why this symptom genuinely carries both observation modes. Most common at menopause, but not female-specific (hyperthyroidism, medication, or falling testosterone in men can also cause it).
records.patient_words_zh: 「突然一陣熱從胸口衝上臉」「熱到滿身大汗，然後又冷下來」「一天發作好幾次，晚上也會熱醒」「臉突然紅通通的」
records.patient_words_en: "A sudden wave of heat rushes up from my chest to my face", "I sweat through and then go cold", "it happens several times a day, and wakes me at night", "my face suddenly turns bright red"

location.why: 全身性陣發性症狀，無固定部位辨證軸

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 夜間發作影響睡眠尤需注意；經期前後發作提示衝任相關

inquiry_zh.why: 夜間發作影響睡眠、與月經週期的關係、更年期階段
情緒緊張、辛辣飲食、飲酒、環境溫度、藥物（如三苯氧胺）
盜汗、心悸、失眠、情緒波動、體重驟變——決定是否需排除甲狀腺或其他內分泌病因
降溫、深呼吸或藥物是否可緩解發作
更年期過渡期的自然病程與突發或異常嚴重的病程需分開評估

inquiry_en.why: Nocturnal episodes affecting sleep, relationship to the menstrual cycle, stage of menopause transition
Emotional stress, spicy food, alcohol, ambient temperature, medication (e.g. tamoxifen)
Night sweats, palpitations, insomnia, mood swings, sudden weight change — determine whether thyroid or other endocrine causes need ruling out
Whether cooling down, deep breathing, or medication reduces episodes
The natural course of the menopause transition needs to be distinguished from a sudden or unusually severe course

differentiation_zh.variant: 潮熱盜汗，五心煩熱，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 午後或夜間潮熱盜汗，五心煩熱，兼腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴、口乾

differentiation_zh.variant: 潮熱面赤，煩躁易怒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 潮熱發作時面赤目赤，煩躁易怒，兼口苦脅痛、失眠多夢

differentiation_zh.variant: 潮熱倦怠，氣短懶言
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 潮熱程度較輕但反覆纏綿，兼倦怠乏力、氣短懶言、自汗

differentiation_en.variant: Hot flashes with night sweats, vexing heat, weak knees and low back
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hot flashes and night sweats worse in the afternoon or at night, vexing heat in the five centers, weak aching low back and knees, dizziness and dry mouth

differentiation_en.variant: Hot flashes with flushed face, irritability
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Flushed face and eyes during episodes, irritability, bitter taste, flank pain, insomnia with excessive dreaming

differentiation_en.variant: Mild but recurring hot flashes, fatigue, shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Milder but persistent hot flashes, with fatigue, shortness of breath, reluctance to speak, and spontaneous sweating

red_flags_zh: 潮熱發作合併暈厥或近乎暈厥 → 需醫療評估
潮熱合併嚴重心悸、胸痛 → 需排除心臟疾病
潮熱合併不明原因體重下降或持續發熱 → 需評估甲狀腺功能或其他系統性病因
與典型模式不符的異常發作（如非更年期年齡突發） → 需更廣泛評估
red_flags_en: Hot flash with syncope or near-syncope → medical evaluation needed
Hot flash with severe palpitations or chest pain → rule out cardiac disease
Hot flash with unexplained weight loss or persistent fever → evaluate thyroid function or other systemic causes
Atypical onset outside the usual menopausal age pattern → broader evaluation warranted
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 與月經週期相關的下腹或盆腔疼痛，可發生於經前、經期或經後，程度輕重不一，嚴重時影響日常活動。是主訴而非診斷——原發性痛經與子宮內膜異位症、子宮肌腺症等續發性痛經的處置方向不同。
records.definition_en: Lower abdominal or pelvic pain tied to the menstrual cycle, occurring before, during, or after menses, ranging from mild to disabling. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — primary dysmenorrhea and secondary dysmenorrhea from endometriosis or adenomyosis need very different management.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一來月經就痛到直不起腰」「經期前幾天就開始悶痛」「痛到要請假」「痛的時候還會拉肚子或想吐」
records.patient_words_en: "The pain doubles me over the moment my period starts", "a dull ache begins a few days before", "it's bad enough to miss work", "I get diarrhea or nausea with the pain"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹痛屬氣滯 · 刺痛拒按有塊屬血瘀 · 冷痛喜溫屬寒凝 · 隱痛喜按屬虛

inquiry_zh.why: 脹痛、刺痛、冷痛、隱痛分屬四類病機，是本症辨證最有重量的一問
經前、經期、經後發作分屬氣滯、血瘀、氣血兩虛不同方向
正中或單側疼痛，單側需考慮附件病變的可能
經血夾塊、經量、發熱、劇痛暈厥——紅旗多掛在這一問
熱敷是否緩解、按壓是否舒服、止痛藥反應
初經後即有（多屬原發性）與近年新發或漸進加重（需排除續發性病因）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Distending, stabbing, cold, or dull pain map to four different mechanisms — the highest-yield question here
Pain before, during, or after menses points toward Qi stagnation, Blood stasis, or Qi-Blood deficiency respectively
Midline versus one-sided pain — one-sided pain raises the possibility of adnexal pathology
Clots in the flow, flow volume, fever, disabling pain with syncope — most red flags hang off this question
Whether heat helps, whether pressure feels good, response to analgesics
Present since menarche (usually primary) versus recent new onset or progressive worsening (needs secondary causes ruled out) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 經前脹痛，情緒誘發加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經前或經期小腹脹痛，隨情緒波動加重，兼胸脅乳房脹悶

differentiation_zh.variant: 經期刺痛拒按，經色紫暗有塊
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經期小腹刺痛拒按，經血紫暗夾血塊，塊下痛減

differentiation_zh.variant: 經期冷痛，得溫則減
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經期小腹冷痛，得熱敷則減，畏寒肢冷，經色暗淡量少

differentiation_zh.variant: 經後隱痛，腰痠倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經後小腹隱隱作痛，喜按，兼腰痠倦怠、面色淡白、經量偏少

differentiation_en.variant: Distending premenstrual pain, worse with emotion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending lower abdominal pain before or during menses, worse with mood swings, with chest, flank and breast fullness

differentiation_en.variant: Stabbing pain during menses, worse for pressure, dark clotted flow
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Stabbing lower abdominal pain tender to pressure during menses, dark purplish flow with clots, pain eases once clots pass

differentiation_en.variant: Cold pain during menses, better for warmth
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cold lower abdominal pain during menses, relieved by a heat pack, cold aversion, pale scanty flow

differentiation_en.variant: Dull ache after menses, low back ache, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague lower abdominal ache after menses, better for pressure, with low back ache, fatigue, pale complexion and scanty flow

red_flags_zh: 劇烈突發下腹痛合併懷孕可能 → 排除子宮外孕，需緊急就醫
痛經合併暈厥、發熱或大量出血 → 需醫療評估
痛經近年新發或進行性加重，尤其伴隨性交痛或不孕 → 需排除子宮內膜異位症等續發性病因
red_flags_en: Sudden severe lower abdominal pain with possible pregnancy → rule out ectopic pregnancy, urgent care needed
Dysmenorrhea with syncope, fever, or heavy bleeding → medical evaluation
New or progressively worsening dysmenorrhea, especially with pain on intercourse or infertility → rule out secondary causes such as endometriosis
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 月經期間出血量明顯超過個人平常量或超過八天，需頻繁更換衛生用品（如每一至兩小時浸透），可伴大血塊。是主訴而非診斷——同一個月經過多可以是子宮肌瘤、凝血功能異常，也可以是中醫的脾不統血、血熱、血瘀。
records.definition_en: Menstrual flow markedly heavier than a person's usual pattern or lasting beyond eight days, needing frequent sanitary product changes (soaking through every one to two hours), sometimes with large clots. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same heavy bleeding can sit under uterine fibroids or a coagulation disorder, or the TCM categories of Spleen failing to govern the Blood, Blood heat, or Blood stasis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「量多到墊子一兩個小時就要換」「夾很多血塊」「來的時候整個人都貧血無力」「經期拖很久停不了」
records.patient_words_en: "I have to change my pad every hour or two", "lots of clots", "I feel anemic and drained during my period", "it drags on and won't stop"

location.why: 月經相關全身性出血症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 經色淡質稀屬虛 · 經色紫暗夾塊屬瘀 · 經色鮮紅質稠屬熱

inquiry_zh.why: 經色淡質稀、紫暗夾塊、鮮紅質稠分屬虛、瘀、熱三個方向
衛生用品更換頻率、是否有大血塊、是否影響日常活動
頭暈心悸（貧血徵象）、暈厥、其他部位異常出血——紅旗都掛在這一問
子宮肌瘤病史、避孕器使用、凝血功能疾病家族史、近期停經前後
近期新發與長年如此的評估積極程度不同，近期新發需優先排除結構性病因

inquiry_en.why: Pale thin flow, dark clotted flow, or bright thick flow point toward deficiency, stasis, or heat respectively
Frequency of product changes, presence of large clots, impact on daily activity
Dizziness and palpitations (signs of anemia), syncope, abnormal bleeding elsewhere — most red flags hang off this question
History of fibroids, IUD use, family history of a bleeding disorder, perimenopause
Recent new onset versus a longstanding pattern differ in urgency — new onset needs structural causes ruled out first

differentiation_zh.variant: 量多色淡質稀，倦怠氣短
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經量多，經色淡質稀，兼倦怠乏力、氣短懶言、面色萎黃，屬脾不統血

differentiation_zh.variant: 量多色紅質稠，口乾煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經量多，經色鮮紅質稠，兼口乾煩熱、面赤、心煩

differentiation_zh.variant: 量多夾大血塊，腹痛拒按
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經量多，夾大血塊，小腹疼痛拒按，塊下痛減

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy pale thin flow, fatigue, shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy flow, pale and thin, with fatigue, shortness of breath, reluctance to speak and a sallow complexion — Spleen failing to govern the Blood

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy bright thick flow, dry mouth, vexing heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy flow, bright red and thick, with dry mouth, vexing heat, flushed face and irritability

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy flow with large clots, pain tender to pressure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy flow with large clots, lower abdominal pain tender to pressure, eases once clots pass

red_flags_zh: 大量出血合併頭暈、暈厥或呼吸困難 → 需緊急醫療評估
浸透衛生用品每小時超過一片，持續數小時 → 需緊急處置
月經過多合併懷孕可能 → 需排除流產或其他妊娠相關病因
red_flags_en: Heavy bleeding with dizziness, syncope, or breathing difficulty → urgent medical evaluation
Soaking more than one pad an hour for several hours running → urgent treatment needed
Heavy bleeding with possible pregnancy → rule out miscarriage or other pregnancy-related causes
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 陰道分泌物在量、色、質、氣味上偏離個人平常狀態，可為量增多、色黃綠、質稠或帶臭味。是主訴而非診斷——同一個帶下異常可以是陰道炎、子宮頸炎、性傳染病，也可以是中醫的脾虛濕盛、濕熱下注、腎陽虛。
records.definition_en: Vaginal discharge that deviates from a person's usual pattern in volume, color, consistency, or odor — increased volume, yellow-green color, thick consistency, or a foul smell. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same abnormal discharge can sit under vaginitis, cervicitis, or a sexually transmitted infection, or the TCM categories of Spleen deficiency with dampness, damp-heat, or Kidney yang deficiency.
records.patient_words_zh: 「分泌物突然變多，顏色也不對」「有異味，很困擾」「黏黏稠稠的，跟平常不一樣」「下面癢又有分泌物」
records.patient_words_en: "Discharge suddenly increased and the color is off", "there's an odor, it's bothering me", "it's thick and different from usual", "itching down there along with the discharge"

location.why: 婦科局部症狀但無部位辨證軸——本症的辨證重點在量色質氣味，不在部位

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；帶下辨證關鍵在色質氣味，該軸不在此詞彙表

inquiry_zh.why: 色黃綠臭穢、外陰搔癢灼熱、發熱腹痛——決定是否需優先排除感染或性傳染病
性行為史、經期前後、抗生素使用、免疫力狀態、糖尿病病史
與月經週期的關係、是否持續或間歇
量的變化、是否需要護墊、對日常生活的影響
急性新發（多屬感染性）與慢性反覆（多屬脾腎功能失調）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Yellow-green foul-smelling discharge, vulvar itching and burning, fever with abdominal pain — determines whether infection or an STI needs ruling out first
Sexual activity history, timing around menses, antibiotic use, immune status, diabetes history
Relationship to the menstrual cycle, continuous versus intermittent
Change in volume, whether a panty liner is needed, impact on daily life
Acute new onset (usually infectious) versus chronic recurrence (usually Spleen-Kidney dysfunction) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 帶下量多色黃質稠，臭穢
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 帶下量多，色黃或黃綠質稠，氣味臭穢，兼外陰搔癢灼熱、小便黃赤

differentiation_zh.variant: 帶下色白質稀，倦怠便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 帶下量多，色白質稀，無明顯臭味，兼倦怠乏力、食少便溏、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 帶下清冷量多，腰膝痠冷
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 帶下量多，質清稀如水，畏寒，兼腰膝痠冷、夜尿頻多

differentiation_en.variant: Heavy, thick, yellow, foul-smelling discharge
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy discharge, yellow or yellow-green and thick, foul-smelling, with vulvar itching and burning and dark yellow urine

differentiation_en.variant: Thin white discharge, fatigue, loose stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy but thin white discharge without a marked odor, with fatigue, poor appetite, loose stool and a sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Copious clear cold discharge, cold aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy, clear, watery discharge with cold aversion, cold aching low back and knees, and frequent night urination

red_flags_zh: 帶下異常合併發熱、劇烈下腹痛 → 排除骨盆腔發炎症，需醫療評估
帶下異常合併懷孕 → 需儘速評估
帶下異常合併大量陰道出血 → 需醫療評估
red_flags_en: Abnormal discharge with fever and severe lower abdominal pain → rule out pelvic inflammatory disease, medical evaluation needed
Abnormal discharge during pregnancy → prompt evaluation needed
Abnormal discharge with heavy vaginal bleeding → medical evaluation needed
sources: MedlinePlus fever guidance（紅旗）

field_sources.definition_zh/en: 一般臨床對 abnormal vaginal discharge 的定義 + 中醫婦科學 帶下病篇一般描述
field_sources.differentiation_zh/en: 中醫婦科學 帶下病分證 + 本 repo pattern_library 對應證型 key_signs_zh 對照
field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: data/research_staging/sym_extension_batch_d_v1.json CR-008 sym.vaginal_discharge + MedlinePlus guidance
field_sources.supporting_measurements: 刻意留空 —— 目前 26 個 outcome metrics 無對應帶下量化項

records.definition_zh: 在兩次正常月經之間出現的陰道出血，量通常較經量少，可為點滴狀或少量鮮血，常發生於排卵期前後。是主訴而非診斷——生理性排卵期出血與息肉、內膜病變等病理性出血需分開評估。
records.definition_en: Vaginal bleeding occurring between two normal menstrual periods, usually lighter than menstrual flow, spotting or a small amount of fresh blood, often around ovulation. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — physiologic ovulatory spotting needs to be distinguished from bleeding caused by polyps or endometrial pathology.
records.patient_words_zh: 「月經來完沒多久又出血」「排卵期會有一點點血」「不是月經期間卻流血」「量很少，一點點粉紅色」
records.patient_words_en: "I bleed again not long after my period ends", "a bit of blood around ovulation", "bleeding when it's not supposed to be my period", "just a little pink spotting"

location.why: 月經週期相關全身性出血症狀，無部位辨證軸

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 出血色紅量少屬熱迫血行 · 出血色淡屬氣虛不能攝血

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 週期中段（排卵期）發作是本症最典型的時間模式

inquiry_zh.why: 是否固定發生於週期中段（排卵期）是判斷生理性與否的第一問
色紅量少與色淡量多分屬熱與氣虛不攝兩個方向
點滴狀與明顯出血量的臨床意義不同
劇烈腹痛、大量出血、懷孕可能、停經後出血——紅旗都掛在這一問
偶發一次與每個週期反覆出現的評估積極程度不同

inquiry_en.why: Whether it reliably occurs mid-cycle (around ovulation) is the first question in judging whether it is physiologic
Bright red scanty blood versus pale heavier blood point toward heat versus Qi failing to contain the Blood respectively
Spotting versus a noticeable amount of bleeding carries different clinical meaning
Severe pain, heavy bleeding, possible pregnancy, postmenopausal bleeding — most red flags hang off this question
A single occurrence versus recurrence every cycle differ in how aggressively they are worked up

differentiation_zh.variant: 出血色紅量少，口乾煩熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經間期出血色鮮紅，量少，兼口乾煩熱、心煩易怒

differentiation_zh.variant: 出血色淡量少，倦怠氣短
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經間期出血色淡質稀，量少，兼倦怠乏力、氣短懶言

differentiation_zh.variant: 出血夾少量血塊，腹痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經間期出血夾雜少量血塊，兼輕微小腹疼痛

differentiation_en.variant: Bright red scanty bleeding, dry mouth, vexing heat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bright red intermenstrual spotting, scanty, with dry mouth, vexing heat, and irritability

differentiation_en.variant: Pale scanty bleeding, fatigue, shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Pale, thin, scanty intermenstrual bleeding, with fatigue, shortness of breath and reluctance to speak

differentiation_en.variant: Bleeding with a small amount of clots, mild pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Intermenstrual bleeding with a few clots, and mild lower abdominal pain

red_flags_zh: 經間期出血合併懷孕可能 → 需儘速評估排除異常妊娠
出血量大、暈厥或劇烈下腹痛 → 需緊急醫療評估
停經後出現任何陰道出血 → 需優先排除子宮內膜病變
red_flags_en: Intermenstrual bleeding with possible pregnancy → prompt evaluation to rule out abnormal pregnancy
Heavy bleeding, syncope, or severe lower abdominal pain → urgent medical evaluation
Any postmenopausal vaginal bleeding → endometrial pathology must be ruled out first
sources: MedlinePlus bleeding guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 乳房脹滿、疼痛或觸痛感，可為單側或雙側，常與月經週期相關（週期性）或無關（非週期性）。是主訴而非診斷——同一個乳房脹痛可以是經前症候群，也可以需要排除乳腺炎、乳腺纖維囊腫或乳癌。
records.definition_en: Fullness, pain, or tenderness in the breast, one- or two-sided, often tied to the menstrual cycle (cyclical) or not (non-cyclical). A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same breast tenderness can sit under premenstrual syndrome, or need mastitis, fibrocystic change, or breast cancer ruled out.
records.patient_words_zh: 「月經前乳房脹到不能碰」「兩邊乳房都痛，摸起來有點腫」「只有一邊痛，之前沒這樣」「內衣一穿就不舒服」
records.patient_words_en: "My breasts are so tender before my period I can't stand touching them", "both breasts ache and feel a bit swollen", "only one side hurts, that's new", "wearing a bra is uncomfortable now"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹痛竄兩脅屬肝鬱氣滯 · 隱痛喜按屬氣血虧虛 · 兼腫塊多屬痰氣鬱結

inquiry_zh.why: 是否隨月經週期規律出現（週期性）是判斷良性與否的第一問
單側與雙側的臨床意義不同，單側持續性需更謹慎評估
脹痛竄痛、隱痛喜按、兼腫塊分屬不同病機
新發腫塊、皮膚或乳頭凹陷、血性乳頭分泌物、局部紅腫熱——紅旗都掛在這一問
咖啡因攝取、荷爾蒙藥物、情緒、哺乳期
多年規律週期性與近期新發持續性的評估方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Whether it reliably tracks the menstrual cycle (cyclical) is the first question in judging whether it is benign
One-sided versus two-sided carries different clinical meaning — persistent one-sided pain needs more careful evaluation
Distending pain radiating outward, dull pain better for pressure, or pain with a lump map to different mechanisms
A new lump, skin or nipple retraction, bloody nipple discharge, focal redness and warmth — most red flags hang off this question
Caffeine intake, hormonal medication, emotion, breastfeeding
Years of regular cyclical pattern versus recent new persistent onset point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 經前脹痛竄兩脅，情緒誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 經前乳房脹痛，竄及兩脅，隨情緒波動加重，經後多可緩解

differentiation_zh.variant: 脹痛兼腫塊，經後緩解不全
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 乳房脹痛兼觸及腫塊，經後緩解不完全，多屬痰氣鬱結

differentiation_zh.variant: 隱痛喜按，經後為著，倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 乳房隱隱作痛，喜按，經後尤為明顯，兼倦怠乏力、面色淡白

differentiation_en.variant: Premenstrual distending pain radiating to the flanks, worse with emotion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Premenstrual breast pain radiating to both flanks, worse with mood swings, usually eases after menses

differentiation_en.variant: Distending pain with a lump, incomplete relief after menses
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breast pain with a palpable lump, only partially relieved after menses — Phlegm-Qi binding

differentiation_en.variant: Dull pain better for pressure, worse after menses, fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague breast ache, better with pressure, most noticeable after menses, with fatigue and a pale complexion

red_flags_zh: 新發不消退的乳房腫塊 → 需影像評估排除乳癌
皮膚凹陷、橘皮樣變化或乳頭凹陷 → 需優先排除乳癌
血性乳頭分泌物 → 需進一步檢查
局部紅腫熱痛合併發熱（尤其哺乳期）→ 排除乳腺炎或膿瘍
red_flags_en: A new persistent breast lump → imaging evaluation to rule out breast cancer
Skin dimpling, orange-peel skin change, or nipple retraction → breast cancer must be ruled out first
Bloody nipple discharge → further workup
Focal redness, warmth and pain with fever (especially while breastfeeding) → rule out mastitis or abscess
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 鼻腔通氣不暢的自覺感受，可為單側或雙側，程度輕重不一，常合併流涕、嗅覺減退。是主訴而非診斷——同一個鼻塞可以是過敏性鼻炎、鼻竇炎、感冒，也可以是中醫的風寒、風熱、肺氣虛。
records.definition_en: The subjective sense of impaired nasal airflow, one- or two-sided, ranging from mild to severe, often with discharge and reduced smell. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same nasal congestion can sit under allergic rhinitis, sinusitis, or the common cold, or the TCM categories of Wind-cold, Wind-heat, or Lung Qi deficiency.
records.patient_words_zh: 「鼻子完全不通，只能用嘴巴呼吸」「一邊鼻孔堵住」「早上起來特別塞」「聞不太到味道」
records.patient_words_en: "My nose is completely blocked, I have to breathe through my mouth", "one nostril is blocked", "it's worst first thing in the morning", "I can barely smell anything"

location.why: 鼻腔局部症狀但無 symptom_taxonomy 部位辨證軸——本症的辨證重點在誘因與分泌物性質，不在頭面部位分區

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 單側慢性鼻塞需優先排除結構性病因（鼻中膈彎曲、腫瘤）

inquiry_zh.why: 單側與雙側的臨床意義不同，單側持續性需考慮結構性病因
流清涕或濁涕、發熱、嗅覺喪失、單側反覆流血——決定病程方向與紅旗
過敏原（塵蟎、花粉、寵物）、感冒、季節變化、環境刺激物
晨起明顯、季節性發作、感冒後持續各有指向
急性（多屬外感）與慢性反覆（多屬過敏或肺氣虛）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: One-sided versus two-sided carries different clinical meaning — persistent one-sided congestion suggests a structural cause
Clear versus thick discharge, fever, loss of smell, recurrent one-sided bleeding — determines the direction of workup and any red flags
Allergens (dust mites, pollen, pets), colds, seasonal change, environmental irritants
Worse on waking, seasonal pattern, or persisting after a cold each point somewhere different
Acute (usually external contraction) versus chronic recurrent (usually allergic or Lung Qi deficiency) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 鼻塞流清涕，惡風寒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 鼻塞聲重，流清涕，噴嚏頻作，惡風寒無汗，多見於外感初起

differentiation_zh.variant: 鼻塞流濁涕黃稠，發熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 鼻塞，涕黃濁而稠，兼發熱、咽痛口渴

differentiation_zh.variant: 鼻塞反覆，遇風冷即發，氣短易感
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 鼻塞反覆發作，遇風冷或換季即誘發，兼自汗、氣短、容易感冒

differentiation_en.variant: Congestion with clear discharge, aversion to wind-cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Heavy-sounding congestion with clear discharge, frequent sneezing, aversion to wind-cold without sweating — typical of early external contraction

differentiation_en.variant: Congestion with thick yellow discharge, fever
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Congestion with thick yellow discharge, fever, sore throat and thirst

differentiation_en.variant: Recurring congestion, triggered by wind or cold, shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Recurring congestion triggered by wind-cold or seasonal change, with spontaneous sweating, shortness of breath and frequent colds

red_flags_zh: 鼻塞合併呼吸道阻塞徵象（無法正常呼吸）→ 屬急診等級
鼻塞合併臉部或眼眶周圍腫脹、意識改變 → 需緊急就醫
鼻塞合併嚴重發熱頭痛 → 排除鼻竇炎併發症
單側持續性鼻塞合併反覆帶血分泌物 → 需進一步檢查排除腫瘤
red_flags_en: Congestion with signs of airway compromise (unable to breathe normally) → emergency-level
Congestion with facial or periorbital swelling and altered mental status → urgent medical evaluation
Congestion with severe fever and headache → rule out sinusitis complications
Persistent one-sided congestion with recurrent bloody discharge → further workup to rule out a tumor
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 自覺視力清晰度下降，物體邊緣模糊不清，可為單眼或雙眼，突發或漸進。是主訴而非診斷——同一個視物模糊可以是屈光不正、白內障、視網膜病變，也可以是中醫的肝腎陰虛、肝血不足、肝陽上亢。
records.definition_en: A subjective loss of visual sharpness, with edges of objects appearing indistinct, in one or both eyes, sudden or gradual. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same blurred vision can sit under refractive error, cataract, or retinal disease, or the TCM categories of Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency, Liver Blood deficiency, or Liver Yang rising.
records.patient_words_zh: 「看東西都霧霧的」「突然一隻眼睛看不清楚」「看遠的模糊，看近的還可以」「視野裡好像有東西擋著」
records.patient_words_en: "Everything looks hazy", "one eye suddenly went blurry", "distance is blurry but close-up is okay", "there's something blocking part of my vision"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 單眼突發視物模糊是重要紅旗指標，需與雙眼漸進性模糊區分

inquiry_zh.why: 單眼與雙眼的臨床意義天差地遠——單眼突發需優先排除眼科急症
突發與漸進的緊急程度完全不同，是本症最關鍵的一問
眼痛、頭痛、飛蚊症突增、視野缺損、其他神經症狀——紅旗都掛在這一問
近距離用眼過度、糖尿病病史、高血壓病史、外傷
休息或矯正眼鏡是否改善

inquiry_en.why: One eye versus both eyes carries very different clinical meaning — sudden one-eyed blurring needs an eye emergency ruled out first
Sudden versus gradual onset carries completely different urgency — the most critical question here
Eye pain, headache, a sudden increase in floaters, visual field loss, other neurologic symptoms — most red flags hang off this question
Prolonged near-work, history of diabetes, history of hypertension, trauma
Whether rest or corrective lenses improve it

differentiation_zh.variant: 視物昏花，腰膝痠軟，頭暈耳鳴
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 視物模糊逐漸加重，兼腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴、五心煩熱

differentiation_zh.variant: 視物模糊，面色萎黃，夜盲
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 視物模糊，尤以昏暗處或夜間為著，兼面色萎黃、頭暈眼花、爪甲不榮

differentiation_zh.variant: 視物模糊，頭暈脹痛，煩躁易怒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 視物模糊兼頭目脹痛，煩躁易怒，面紅目赤，多在情緒波動或熬夜後加重

differentiation_en.variant: Blurred vision, weak aching low back and knees, dizziness, tinnitus
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Gradually worsening blurred vision, with weak aching low back and knees, dizziness, tinnitus and vexing heat in the five centers

differentiation_en.variant: Blurred vision, sallow complexion, night blindness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Blurred vision, most marked in dim light or at night, with a sallow complexion, dizziness and poorly nourished nails

differentiation_en.variant: Blurred vision, distending headache, irritability
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Blurred vision with distending head and eye pain, irritability, red face and eyes, worse with emotional swings or late nights

red_flags_zh: 突發單眼或雙眼視力喪失或明顯改變 → 屬急症，需立即眼科或神經科評估
視物模糊合併單側肢體無力、言語障礙 → 排除中風
劇烈眼痛、外傷或化學物質接觸史 → 需緊急眼科評估
視野中出現閃光、飄浮物驟增或如簾幕遮蔽 → 排除視網膜剝離
red_flags_en: Sudden loss or marked change of vision in one or both eyes → emergency, needs immediate ophthalmologic or neurologic evaluation
Blurred vision with one-sided limb weakness or speech impairment → rule out stroke
Severe eye pain, trauma, or chemical exposure history → urgent ophthalmologic evaluation
New flashes of light, a sudden shower of floaters, or a curtain-like loss of vision → rule out retinal detachment
sources: CDC stroke signs and symptoms；MedlinePlus eye injury guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 眼部乾澀、異物感、灼熱或刺癢的自覺感受，常因淚液分泌不足或蒸發過快所致，可伴視力波動。是主訴而非診斷——同一個目乾可以是乾眼症、修格蘭氏症候群，也可以是中醫的肝腎陰虛、肝血不足。
records.definition_en: The subjective sense of dryness, grittiness, burning, or itching in the eyes, usually from insufficient tear production or excessive evaporation, sometimes with fluctuating vision. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same dry eyes can sit under dry eye disease or Sjögren's syndrome, or the TCM categories of Liver-Kidney Yin deficiency or Liver Blood deficiency.
records.patient_words_zh: 「眼睛乾乾澀澀的，好像有沙子」「一直想眨眼」「螢幕看久了眼睛就痛」「早上起來眼睛黏黏的」
records.patient_words_en: "My eyes feel dry and gritty, like there's sand in them", "I keep wanting to blink", "screen time makes my eyes ache", "my eyes feel sticky when I wake up"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 長時間用眼（螢幕）後加重、傍晚加重是本症常見的時間模式

inquiry_zh.why: 長時間看螢幕、配戴隱形眼鏡、乾燥環境、更年期、自體免疫疾病病史
傍晚加重、長時間用眼後加重是常見模式
口乾、關節痛（需考慮修格蘭氏症候群）、視力波動
人工淚液是否有效、休息是否改善
長年慢性與近期新發需分開考慮誘因

inquiry_en.why: Prolonged screen use, contact lens wear, dry environments, menopause, history of autoimmune disease
Worse in the evening or after prolonged eye use are common patterns
Dry mouth, joint pain (consider Sjögren's syndrome), fluctuating vision
Whether artificial tears help, whether rest improves it
Longstanding chronic versus recent new onset point toward different triggers to consider

differentiation_zh.variant: 目乾澀，五心煩熱，腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眼乾澀日久不癒，兼五心煩熱、腰膝痠軟、口乾少津

differentiation_zh.variant: 目乾澀，倦怠，面色淡白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眼乾澀，視物易疲勞，兼倦怠乏力、面色淡白、頭暈眼花

differentiation_zh.variant: 目乾澀脹痛，煩躁易怒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 眼乾澀兼灼熱脹痛，煩躁易怒，口苦，多在熬夜或情緒波動後加重

differentiation_en.variant: Dry gritty eyes, vexing heat, weak aching low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Chronic dry gritty eyes, with vexing heat in the five centers, weak aching low back and knees, dry mouth with little fluid

differentiation_en.variant: Dry gritty eyes, fatigue, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dry gritty eyes with easy visual fatigue, fatigue, pale complexion, dizziness

differentiation_en.variant: Dry, gritty, burning eyes, irritability
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dry gritty eyes with burning distending pain, irritability, bitter taste, worse after late nights or emotional upset

red_flags_zh: 劇烈眼痛、明顯畏光 → 需緊急眼科評估
外傷或化學物質接觸史 → 需緊急眼科評估
突發視力改變 → 需優先排除其他眼科急症
red_flags_en: Severe eye pain or marked photophobia → urgent ophthalmologic evaluation
Trauma or chemical exposure history → urgent ophthalmologic evaluation
Sudden vision change → other eye emergencies must be ruled out first
sources: MedlinePlus eye injury guidance（紅旗）

records.definition_zh: 引發搔抓慾望的皮膚不適感，可為局部或全身性，可伴或不伴皮疹。是主訴而非診斷——同一個搔癢可以是接觸性皮膚炎、蕁麻疹、肝腎疾病、淋巴瘤，也可以是中醫的風邪、血熱、血虛生風、濕熱。
records.definition_en: A skin sensation that provokes the urge to scratch, localized or generalized, with or without a visible rash. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same pruritus can sit under contact dermatitis, urticaria, hepatic or renal disease, or lymphoma, or the TCM categories of external Wind, Blood heat, Blood deficiency generating Wind, or damp-heat.
records.patient_words_zh: 「全身癢到睡不著」「一個地方一直癢，抓到破皮」「換季就開始癢」「越抓越癢」
records.patient_words_en: "I'm itchy all over, can't sleep", "one spot keeps itching, I've scratched it raw", "it starts every time the season changes", "the more I scratch the itchier it gets"

quality.why: symptom_quality 為疼痛性質詞彙，不適用；搔癢的辨證關鍵在遊走性／固定性、有無滲液灼熱，該軸不在此詞彙表

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 夜間為甚多屬血虛生風；遇熱加重多屬血熱

inquiry_zh.why: 局部與全身性、是否遊走不定，指向完全不同的病因方向
夜間為甚屬血虛生風；遇熱或情緒波動加重屬血熱
新用藥物、新接觸物質、季節、皮膚乾燥、肝腎疾病史
皮疹型態、黃疸、體重下降、淋巴結腫大——紅旗都掛在這一問
保濕、冷敷、抗組織胺是否有效
急性新發與慢性反覆超過六週（需查系統性病因）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Localized versus generalized, and whether it wanders, point toward completely different causes
Worse at night suggests Blood deficiency generating Wind; worse with heat or emotion suggests Blood heat
New medication, new contact substance, season, dry skin, history of hepatic or renal disease
Rash pattern, jaundice, weight loss, lymphadenopathy — most red flags hang off this question
Whether moisturizing, cold compresses, or antihistamines help
Acute new onset versus chronic recurrence beyond six weeks (needs systemic causes worked up) point toward different management

differentiation_zh.variant: 皮膚搔癢遊走不定，惡風
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 搔癢部位遊走不定，此起彼伏，遇風加重，發病較急

differentiation_zh.variant: 搔癢兼紅疹灼熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 皮膚搔癢，兼紅色皮疹灼熱，遇熱或情緒波動加重，抓破易出血

differentiation_zh.variant: 搔癢反覆，皮膚乾燥，夜間為甚
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 皮膚乾燥脫屑，搔癢夜間尤甚，反覆纏綿，兼面色萎黃、頭暈眼花

differentiation_zh.variant: 搔癢滲液，苔黃膩
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 皮膚搔癢兼滲液或水皰，患處潮濕，多見於下肢或陰部，苔黃膩

differentiation_en.variant: Wandering itch, aversion to wind
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Itching that wanders from place to place, appearing and subsiding, worse with wind exposure, relatively acute onset

differentiation_en.variant: Itching with red, hot rash
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Itching with a red, hot rash, worse with heat or emotional upset, bleeds easily when scratched

differentiation_en.variant: Recurring itch, dry skin, worse at night
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dry, flaking skin with itching worse at night, persistent and recurring, with a sallow complexion and dizziness

differentiation_en.variant: Itching with oozing, greasy yellow coating
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Itching with oozing or blistering, moist affected area, often on the lower limbs or genitals, with a greasy yellow tongue coating

red_flags_zh: 搔癢合併臉部或舌頭腫脹、呼吸困難 → 排除過敏性休克，屬急診等級
蕁麻疹合併呼吸困難 → 屬急診等級
搔癢合併黃疸或其他全身性疾病徵象 → 需醫療評估
搔癢合併水皰或大面積脫皮 → 需緊急皮膚科評估
red_flags_en: Itching with facial or tongue swelling and breathing difficulty → rule out anaphylaxis, emergency-level
Hives with breathing difficulty → emergency-level
Itching with jaundice or other signs of systemic illness → medical evaluation
Itching with blistering or extensive skin peeling → urgent dermatologic evaluation
sources: MedlinePlus emergency symptom guide（紅旗）
