aliases_en: Exertional leg cramping relieved by rest
records.definition_zh: 行走或爬樓梯一段固定距離後，小腿（或臀部、大腿）出現痠痛、抽筋或無力感，休息數分鐘後緩解，再走同樣距離又復發。是周邊動脈疾病（PAD）的典型症狀，由動脈粥狀硬化造成的血流不足所致。突發劇痛合併肢體冰冷蒼白無脈是血管急症，與慢性間歇性跛行需嚴格區分。
records.definition_en: Aching, cramping, or weakness in the calf (or buttock/thigh) that appears after walking or climbing stairs a consistent distance, resolves with a few minutes of rest, and recurs after walking the same distance again. The classic symptom of peripheral arterial disease (PAD), caused by atherosclerotic narrowing of blood flow. Sudden severe pain with a cold, pale, pulseless limb is a vascular emergency and must be strictly distinguished from chronic intermittent claudication.
records.patient_words_zh: 「走一段路小腿就痠痛，要停下來休息才能繼續走」「爬樓梯爬到一半腿就沒力」「休息一下痛就消了，再走又開始」
records.patient_words_en: "My calf starts aching after walking a certain distance and I have to stop", "My leg gives out partway up the stairs", "The pain goes away with rest but comes back when I walk again"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 痠痛乏力多屬氣虛/脈絡失養；冷痛遇寒加重多屬寒凝血瘀

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 與行走距離固定相關、休息可緩解，是間歇性跛行區別於其他腿痛的核心時間型態

inquiry_zh.why: 行走固定距離後誘發、休息緩解——PAD 典型型態；是否有糖尿病、吸煙、高血壓病史——PAD 危險因子
足部/小腿傷口癒合不良、皮膚顏色改變、毛髮脫落——慢性缺血徵象；靜息時仍痛——病情已進展
是否為突發劇痛合併肢體冰冷蒼白——需與慢性間歇性跛行嚴格區分，前者為血管急症

inquiry_en.why: Provoked after a consistent walking distance, relieved by rest — the classic PAD pattern; diabetes, smoking, hypertension history — PAD risk factors
Poorly healing foot/leg wounds, skin color change, hair loss — signs of chronic ischemia; pain persisting at rest — disease progression
Whether onset was sudden and severe with a cold, pale limb — must be strictly distinguished from chronic intermittent claudication, as the former is a vascular emergency

differentiation_zh.variant: 步行後小腿痠痛乏力，休息緩解，兼神疲氣短
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 跛行兼全身氣虛徵象，氣虛不能榮養脈絡

differentiation_zh.variant: 步行後小腿冷痛，遇寒加重，膚色蒼白或紫暗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 跛行兼冷痛、膚色紫暗，寒凝血瘀，脈絡阻滯

differentiation_en.variant: Calf aching and weakness after walking, relieved by rest, with fatigue and shortness of breath
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Claudication with generalized Qi-deficiency signs — Qi insufficient to nourish the channels

differentiation_en.variant: Cold calf pain after walking, worse with cold, pale or dusky-purple skin
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Claudication with cold pain and discoloration — Cold congealing the Blood, obstructing the channels

red_flags_zh: 突發劇烈肢體疼痛合併肢體冰冷、蒼白、脈搏消失或麻木無力 → 需緊急就醫排除急性肢體缺血，屬血管外科急症
跛行進展為靜息時仍持續疼痛，或足部/腳趾出現癒合不良的傷口、發黑 → 需醫療評估，可能已進展至嚴重周邊動脈疾病
跛行合併已知糖尿病、吸煙史，或合併心臟病/腦中風病史 → 需醫療評估整體心血管風險
red_flags_en: Sudden severe limb pain with a cold, pale limb, absent pulse, or numbness/weakness → seek care immediately to rule out acute limb ischemia, a vascular surgical emergency
Claudication progressing to pain persisting at rest, or poorly healing/blackened wounds on the foot or toes → medical evaluation needed, possible progression to severe peripheral arterial disease
Claudication in someone with known diabetes, smoking history, or a history of heart disease/stroke → medical evaluation of overall cardiovascular risk
sources: MedlinePlus: Peripheral Arterial Disease | PAD（https://medlineplus.gov/peripheralarterialdisease.html）
MedlinePlus: Leg pain（https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003182.htm）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: MedlinePlus article 003182（冰冷蒼白、活動加重休息緩解、傷口癒合不良為條目原文列出的警訊）逐條擴寫

records.definition_zh: 一側或兩側肋弓下方（季肋部）的疼痛，中醫責之於肝膽經循行所過；西醫則對應右上腹（肝膽）或左上腹（脾臟）區域的體表投影。是主訴，不是診斷——脅痛可見於肝膽疾病、肋間神經痛、帶狀疱疹前驅期等多種病因。
records.definition_en: Pain beneath the costal margin, on one or both sides. In TCM this region is traversed by the Liver and Gallbladder channels; in biomedicine it corresponds to the right upper quadrant (liver/biliary) or left upper quadrant (spleen) surface projection. It is a presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — hypochondriac pain appears in hepatobiliary disease, intercostal neuralgia, and the prodrome of herpes zoster among other causes.
records.patient_words_zh: 「肋骨下面脹痛」「一按就痛，深呼吸也痛」「悶悶的，說不上來哪裡」「像被東西頂住」「痛到牽扯後背」
records.patient_words_en: "Aching under my ribs", "hurts when I press on it, and when I take a deep breath", "a dull discomfort, hard to pin down", "like something's pressing there", "the pain pulls through to my back"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 脹屬氣滯 · 刺屬血瘀 · 隱屬虛（肝陰虛）· 灼屬肝膽濕熱

inquiry_zh.why: 右脅多指向肝膽；左脅需排除脾臟；沿肋間放射提示肋間神經或帶狀疱疹
脹痛屬氣滯、刺痛屬血瘀、隱痛屬肝陰虛、灼熱脹痛屬肝膽濕熱
情緒波動誘發或加重提示肝氣鬱結；進食油膩後加重提示膽道問題
黃疸、發熱、噁心提示膽道/肝臟病變；皮膚出現水泡提示帶狀疱疹；胸悶心悸需排除心因性放射痛
太息後緩解提示氣滯；按之痛減屬虛，拒按屬實
急性劇痛與慢性反覆脹痛的鑑別方向完全不同

inquiry_en.why: Right-sided pain points toward liver/biliary disease; left-sided pain should prompt evaluation of the spleen; a band along one intercostal space suggests intercostal neuralgia or herpes zoster
Distending = qi stagnation, stabbing = blood stasis, dull/vague = Liver yin deficiency, burning-distending = Liver-Gallbladder damp-heat
Onset or worsening with emotional upset suggests Liver qi stagnation; worse after fatty meals suggests biliary disease
Jaundice, fever or nausea suggest hepatobiliary disease; a vesicular skin eruption suggests herpes zoster; chest tightness or palpitations should prompt ruling out a cardiac source of referred pain
Relief with sighing suggests qi stagnation; better with pressure = deficiency, worse with pressure = excess
Acute severe pain and chronic recurrent distension are worked up very differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 脅肋脹痛，隨情緒增減
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脅肋脹痛，走竄不定，因情志抑鬱或惱怒而發作或加重，胸悶善太息

differentiation_zh.variant: 脅肋刺痛，痛處固定
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 痛處固定不移、拒按，入夜尤甚，脅下或見痞塊，舌質紫暗或有瘀斑

differentiation_zh.variant: 脅肋隱痛，悠悠不休
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脅肋隱痛，勞累加重，兼口燥咽乾、頭暈目眩、五心煩熱

differentiation_zh.variant: 脅肋脹痛灼熱，口苦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脅肋脹痛且有灼熱感，口苦口黏，或見黃疸，小便黃赤，舌苔黃膩

differentiation_en.variant: Distending pain that fluctuates with mood
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending, migratory pain under the ribs, brought on or worsened by emotional depression or anger, with chest tightness and frequent sighing

differentiation_en.variant: Fixed stabbing pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Fixed, unmoving pain, worse for pressure and worse at night, sometimes a palpable mass under the ribs, dusky or ecchymotic tongue

differentiation_en.variant: Dull, lingering pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Vague continuous pain worse with fatigue, with dry mouth and throat, dizziness and five-center heat

differentiation_en.variant: Burning distending pain with a bitter taste
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Distending pain with a burning quality, bitter sticky taste in the mouth, sometimes jaundice, dark urine, yellow greasy tongue coating

red_flags_zh: 合併黑便、吐血 → 排除消化道出血
合併高燒 → 排除膽囊炎／膽管炎
合併皮膚鞏膜黃染 → 排除膽道阻塞
合併頭暈、意識模糊或暈厥 → 排除脾臟破裂等內出血急症
合併呼吸困難或胸悶 → 需排除心因性放射痛
劇痛合併腹部膨脹，或用力活動後加劇 → 需立即就醫
red_flags_en: Blood in stool or vomit accompanying the pain → rule out gastrointestinal bleeding
High fever with the pain → rule out cholecystitis/cholangitis
Jaundice (yellowing of skin/eyes) accompanying the pain → rule out biliary obstruction
Dizziness, confusion or fainting with the pain → rule out internal bleeding such as splenic rupture
Trouble breathing or chest tightness with the pain → rule out a cardiac source of referred pain
Severe pain with visible abdominal swelling, or pain that worsens with exertion → seek care immediately
sources: Cleveland Clinic, "Upper Abdominal Pain" (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/24736-upper-abdominal-pain, retrieved 2026-08-11) — regional anatomy and red flags

records.definition_zh: 咽部疼痛不適，常在吞嚥時加重，西醫多稱咽炎。是主訴，可見於外感初起、慢性咽炎、扁桃體炎等多種病因，本卡記錄該問什麼、紅旗在哪，不下結論。
records.definition_en: Discomfort or pain in the throat, often worse with swallowing (odynophagia); termed pharyngitis in biomedicine when inflammation is present. A presenting complaint seen in early external contraction, chronic pharyngitis, tonsillitis and more — this card records what to ask and where the red flags are, not a conclusion.
records.patient_words_zh: 「吞口水都痛」「喉嚨卡卡的，像有東西」「乾痛、刺痛」「一講話就痛」「痛到耳朵那邊」
records.patient_words_en: "Hurts even to swallow saliva", "feels like something's stuck in there", "dry and stinging", "hurts when I talk", "the pain radiates up to my ear"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 灼痛屬熱 · 乾痛屬陰虛

inquiry_zh.why: 紅腫灼痛屬風熱／肺胃熱盛；乾痛不紅屬陰虛
受涼後發作提示外感風寒或風熱；熬夜、上火食物後加重提示陰虛或胃熱
發熱惡寒提示外感表證；聲音嘶啞、吞嚥困難、流口水需進入紅旗流程
新發數日與反覆慢性咽痛的處置方向不同——慢性者需考慮陰虛或胃食道逆流

inquiry_en.why: Red, swollen, burning pain suggests wind-heat or excess Lung/Stomach heat; dry pain without redness suggests yin deficiency
Onset after cold exposure suggests external wind-cold/wind-heat contraction; worse with late nights or heaty foods suggests yin deficiency or Stomach heat
Fever with aversion to cold suggests an exterior pattern; hoarseness, difficulty swallowing or drooling enter the red-flag pathway
A new few-day sore throat and a chronic recurrent one point in different directions — chronic cases warrant considering yin deficiency or reflux

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽紅腫痛，發熱惡風
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽部紅腫疼痛，吞嚥不利，發熱惡風，咳嗽痰黃，舌尖紅苔薄黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽痛乾癢，惡寒無汗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽部微痛而乾癢，惡寒發熱、無汗、鼻塞流清涕，舌苔薄白

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽乾灼痛，午後加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽部乾痛，午後或夜間加重，兼乾咳少痰、手足心熱、舌紅少苔

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽痛灼熱，口臭便秘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽喉腫痛灼熱，口臭，牙齦腫痛，大便秘結，舌紅苔黃

differentiation_en.variant: Red swollen pain with fever and aversion to wind
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Red, swollen, painful throat with difficulty swallowing, fever with aversion to wind, cough with yellow phlegm, red tongue tip with thin yellow coating

differentiation_en.variant: Dry itchy pain with aversion to cold, no sweat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Mild dry, itchy throat pain, aversion to cold and fever without sweating, nasal congestion with clear discharge, thin white tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Dry burning pain, worse in the afternoon
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dry painful throat worse in the afternoon or at night, with dry cough and scant phlegm, warm palms and soles, red tongue with little coating

differentiation_en.variant: Burning pain with bad breath and constipation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Swollen burning throat pain, bad breath, swollen painful gums, constipation, red tongue with yellow coating

red_flags_zh: 合併呼吸困難 → 立即就醫
流口水、無法吞嚥口水、聲音悶濁（含物聲）→ 提示扁桃體周膿瘍
張口困難、單側劇痛、懸雍垂偏移 → 提示扁桃體周膿瘍
喘鳴聲、身體前傾（三腳架姿勢）、嚴重吞嚥困難但扁桃體未見明顯腫大 → 需視為會厭炎立即處理
頸部僵硬腫脹，或體溫超過 39°C
咽痛超過數日未緩解或反覆發作，合併頸部淋巴結腫大或皮疹
red_flags_en: Trouble breathing accompanying the sore throat → seek care immediately
Drooling, inability to swallow secretions, or a muffled "hot potato" voice → suggests peritonsillar abscess
Trismus (difficulty opening the jaw), severe unilateral throat pain, or uvula deviation → suggests peritonsillar abscess
Stridor, tripod positioning, severe dysphagia without obvious tonsillar swelling → treat as epiglottitis until proven otherwise
Neck stiffness or swelling, or fever above 39°C/102°F
Sore throat persisting beyond several days or recurring, with swollen neck lymph nodes or a rash
sources: MedlinePlus, Sore throat (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000655.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11)
StatPearls, Peritonsillar Abscess (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK519520/, retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 咽部搔癢不適，常誘發咳嗽或清嗓，屬刺激性症狀而非診斷。西醫無獨立病名，多歸因於過敏、鼻涕倒流、感染或胃食道逆流刺激咽部。
records.definition_en: A scratchy, tickly sensation in the throat that often provokes coughing or throat-clearing — an irritative symptom rather than a diagnosis. Biomedicine has no dedicated diagnostic entity for it; it is generally attributed to allergy, postnasal drip, infection, or reflux irritating the pharynx.
records.patient_words_zh: 「喉嚨癢癢的，一直想咳」「像有東西搔著」「乾癢，講話久了更癢」「一陣一陣的癢」
records.patient_words_en: "My throat's itchy, I keep wanting to cough", "like something's tickling in there", "dry and itchy, gets worse the longer I talk", "comes in waves"

laterality.why: 咽癢多為正中對稱，側性意義有限

inquiry_zh.why: 接觸過敏原、灰塵或冷空氣誘發提示過敏性；受涼後新發提示外感初起
鼻塞流涕、打噴嚏提示鼻源性；胸悶灼熱提示胃食道逆流；若進展為咽喉緊縮、喘鳴需進入紅旗流程
夜間或平躺加重提示鼻涕倒流或胃食道逆流
急性新發與慢性反覆（過敏性鼻炎、逆流）處置方向不同

inquiry_en.why: Onset with allergen, dust or cold-air exposure suggests an allergic cause; new onset after cold exposure suggests early external contraction
Nasal congestion and sneezing suggest a nasal source; chest burning suggests reflux; progression to throat tightness or wheezing enters the red-flag pathway
Worse at night or lying flat suggests postnasal drip or reflux
New acute itching and chronic recurrent itching (allergic rhinitis, reflux) are worked up differently

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽癢咳嗽，遇風寒發作
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽癢即咳，遇風冷加重，鼻塞流清涕，舌苔薄白

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽癢乾咳，鼻塞黃涕
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽癢咳嗽，痰黃或無痰，鼻涕黃濁，咽部微紅，舌紅苔薄黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 咽癢反覆，遇異味誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 咽癢陣作，遇灰塵、異味、冷空氣即發，喉間似有痰黏著感，反覆難癒

differentiation_en.variant: Itch triggers cough, worse with wind-cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Throat itch immediately triggers cough, worse with wind or cold exposure, nasal congestion with clear discharge, thin white tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Itchy dry cough with yellow nasal discharge
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Itch-triggered cough with yellow or absent phlegm, thick yellow nasal discharge, mildly red throat, red tongue with thin yellow coating

differentiation_en.variant: Recurrent itch triggered by odours
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Paroxysmal throat itch triggered by dust, strong smells or cold air, a sticky phlegm-like sensation in the throat, recurrent and hard to resolve

safety_review_sources: Cleveland Clinic, "Itchy Throat (Scratchy Throat) Causes & Treatment", https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/itchy-throat, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 咽癢進展為咽喉緊縮感、吞嚥困難或喘鳴 → 需視為過敏性休克前兆，立即就醫
合併新發發熱、明顯腫脹或皮疹
曾有嚴重（過敏性休克）過敏反應病史者，本次咽癢須提高警覺
持續超過一週未緩解或逐漸加重，儘管已嘗試居家緩解措施
red_flags_en: Itching progresses to throat tightness, difficulty swallowing, or wheezing → treat as possible anaphylaxis and seek emergency care
New fever, significant swelling, or a rash accompanies the itch
History of a serious (anaphylactic) allergic reaction — treat a new throat itch with heightened caution
Persists beyond one week or worsens despite self-care
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Itchy Throat (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/itchy-throat, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 咽癢／喉癢辨證內容

records.definition_zh: 病人或家屬自覺記憶力較前減退，忘記近期事務、人名或約定，程度超過該年齡的正常遺忘。是主訴，不等於失智症診斷——需先鑑別是否為可逆病因（甲狀腺低下、憂鬱、睡眠障礙、維生素缺乏等）。
records.definition_en: Self- or family-reported decline in the ability to recall recent events, names, or appointments, beyond what is typical for the person's age. A presenting complaint, not a diagnosis of dementia — it first requires ruling out reversible causes (hypothyroidism, depression, sleep disorders, vitamin deficiency, etc.).
records.patient_words_zh: 「常常忘記東西放哪」「講到一半忘記要講什麼」「約會常常忘記」「腦袋空空的，想不起來」
records.patient_words_en: "I keep forgetting where I put things", "I lose my train of thought mid-sentence", "I keep forgetting appointments", "my mind just goes blank"

location.why: 非部位性症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 緩慢漸進與突然明顯惡化的鑑別方向不同——後者需優先排除器質性病變
兼失眠多夢、心悸提示心脾兩虛；兼腰膝痠軟、耳鳴提示腎精不足；兼情緒低落提示憂鬱相關
睡眠不足、長期壓力、更年期前後發生，各有不同指向
說話時找不到常用詞、完成熟悉工作變慢、在熟悉地方迷路、情緒或行為明顯改變 → 需提高警覺並轉診評估

inquiry_en.why: Slow gradual decline versus sudden marked worsening point in different directions — the latter should prompt ruling out an organic cause first

With insomnia, dream-disturbed sleep and palpitations suggests Heart-Spleen deficiency; with low back/knee soreness and tinnitus suggests Kidney essence deficiency; with low mood suggests a depression-related cause
Poor sleep, chronic stress, or onset around menopause each point somewhere different
Forgetting common words mid-sentence, taking noticeably longer on familiar tasks, getting lost in a familiar place, or a marked change in mood/behaviour → raise concern and warrant referral

differentiation_zh.variant: 健忘兼心悸失眠、多夢
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 健忘伴心悸、失眠多夢、食少倦怠、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 健忘兼腰膝痠軟、耳鳴
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 健忘日益加重，兼耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、齒搖髮脫，多見於年長者

differentiation_zh.variant: 健忘兼情緒抑鬱、胸悶
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 健忘伴情緒低落、胸脅脹悶、善太息，因情志不遂而加重

differentiation_zh.variant: 健忘兼頭重痰多
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 健忘遲鈍，頭重如裹，胸悶痰多，身重困倦

differentiation_en.variant: Forgetfulness with palpitations, insomnia and dream-disturbed sleep
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Forgetfulness with palpitations, insomnia with dream-disturbed sleep, poor appetite, fatigue, sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Forgetfulness with weak low back/knees and tinnitus
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Progressively worsening forgetfulness with tinnitus, weak aching low back and knees, loosening teeth and hair loss, mainly in older patients

differentiation_en.variant: Forgetfulness with depressed mood and chest tightness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Forgetfulness with low mood, chest and rib-side distension, frequent sighing, worse with emotional frustration

differentiation_en.variant: Forgetfulness with heavy head and copious phlegm
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sluggish forgetfulness, heavy muzzy head, chest fullness with copious phlegm, heavy tired body

safety_review_sources: Mayo Clinic, "Memory loss: When to seek help" — corroborated via indexed search excerpts of https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/alzheimers-disease/in-depth/memory-loss/art-20046326 (direct fetch blocked by site bot-protection, HTTP 403); not independently confirmed by direct page render, flagged for manual verification
red_flags_zh: 說話時常忘記常用詞彙或用詞錯亂
完成熟悉的日常工作明顯變慢
把物品放在不合常理的地方（如鑰匙放進冰箱）
在熟悉的地方走路或開車時迷路
反覆詢問同樣的資訊
合併明顯的情緒或行為改變
red_flags_en: Forgetting common words when speaking, or word mix-ups
Taking noticeably longer to complete familiar tasks
Misplacing items in inappropriate places (e.g. keys in the fridge)
Getting lost while walking or driving in a familiar area
Repeatedly asking for the same information
An unexplained change in mood or behaviour accompanying the memory issue
sources: Mayo Clinic, Memory loss: When to seek help — corroborated via search index, direct fetch blocked (2026-08-11), needs manual verification before treating as fully confirmed
