records.definition_zh: 平躺時出現或加重的呼吸困難，需坐起或墊高才能緩解，西醫稱端坐呼吸（orthopnea），常見於左心衰竭。是主訴，需優先評估心肺功能，不宜當作單純睡姿問題處理。
records.definition_en: Breathlessness that occurs or worsens specifically when lying flat and is relieved by sitting or propping up — termed orthopnea in biomedicine, classically a sign of left-sided heart failure. This is a presenting complaint requiring prompt cardiopulmonary evaluation, not simply a sleeping-position issue.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一躺下就喘」「要墊兩三個枕頭才睡得著」「半夜喘醒，要坐起來才舒服」「躺著會咳嗽、胸悶」
records.patient_words_en: "I get short of breath the moment I lie down", "I need two or three pillows to sleep", "I wake up gasping and have to sit up", "lying down makes me cough and feel tight in the chest"

location.why: 非部位性症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

severity.why: 實例值（需幾個枕頭），屬病例層

inquiry_zh.why: 平臥後數分鐘內出現，坐起即緩解，是端坐呼吸的典型模式
需要墊高的枕頭數（一枕、兩枕、三枕）常用作嚴重度的臨床速記
胸悶胸痛、心悸、下肢水腫提示心衰；夜間陣發性呼吸困難（睡中喘醒）是相關且更具特異性的紅旗
新發與逐漸加重的端坐呼吸都需要心肺評估，但新發者更急迫

inquiry_en.why: Onset within minutes of lying flat, relieved by sitting up, is the classic orthopnea pattern
The number of pillows needed ("two-pillow", "three-pillow" orthopnea) is a standard clinical shorthand for severity
Chest tightness or pain, palpitations and leg swelling suggest heart failure; paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea (waking gasping for air) is a closely related and more specific red flag
Both new-onset and gradually worsening orthopnea need cardiopulmonary evaluation, but new onset is more urgent

differentiation_zh.variant: 不能平臥兼心悸、下肢水腫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 平臥即喘，心悸怔忡，下肢浮腫，畏寒肢冷，唇甲青紫

differentiation_zh.variant: 不能平臥兼咳喘痰多
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 臥則氣喘加重，咳嗽痰多色白質稀，胸悶，喉間痰鳴

differentiation_zh.variant: 不能平臥兼氣短乏力
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 動則氣喘，平臥尤甚，氣短乏力，自汗，聲低懶言

differentiation_en.variant: Orthopnea with palpitations and leg swelling
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless on lying flat, palpitations, leg swelling, aversion to cold with cold limbs, cyanotic lips and nails

differentiation_en.variant: Orthopnea with cough and copious phlegm
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Worse lying flat, cough with copious thin white phlegm, chest fullness, rattling phlegm sounds in the throat

differentiation_en.variant: Orthopnea with shortness of breath and fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Breathless on exertion, worse lying flat, shortness of breath and fatigue, spontaneous sweating, low soft voice

safety_review_sources: NCBI Bookshelf (Clinical Methods, 3rd ed.), "Dyspnea, Orthopnea, and Paroxysmal Nocturnal Dyspnea", https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK213/, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 端坐呼吸本身即為心肺疾病（最常見為左心衰竭）的警示徵象，出現即需就醫評估
合併胸悶或胸痛
合併喘鳴聲或新發／加重咳嗽
合併心悸
需要墊的枕頭數逐漸增加，提示嚴重度惡化
夜間陣發性呼吸困難（睡夢中喘醒）——與端坐呼吸密切相關但更具特異性的紅旗
red_flags_en: Orthopnea itself is a red-flag sign of cardiopulmonary disease, most commonly left-sided heart failure — its presence warrants evaluation on its own
Accompanying chest tightness or chest pain
Accompanying wheezing or a new/worsening cough
Accompanying palpitations
Needing progressively more pillows to sleep, indicating worsening severity
Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea (waking gasping for breath) — a closely related and more specific red flag pointing to heart failure
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Orthopnea (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/orthopnea, retrieved 2026-08-11)
NCBI Bookshelf, Dyspnea Orthopnea and PND (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK213/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 喘證／心悸相關端坐呼吸辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Orthopnea + NCBI Bookshelf Clinical Methods ch.35 (both retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 鼻黏膜受刺激後突然、不自主地經鼻和口噴出氣流的反射動作，頻繁或陣發性噴嚏是過敏性鼻炎的典型表現之一。是生理反射兼主訴，本身極少為嚴重疾病的表現。
records.definition_en: A sudden, forceful, involuntary expulsion of air through the nose and mouth triggered by irritation of the nasal mucosa; when frequent or occurring in bouts, it is a hallmark of allergic or non-allergic rhinitis. A physiological reflex and presenting complaint that is rarely, on its own, a sign of serious disease.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一直打噴嚏，停不下來」「一接觸灰塵就狂打噴嚏」「早上起床特別容易打噴嚏」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't stop sneezing", "I sneeze in fits whenever I'm around dust", "I sneeze a lot right after waking up"

location.why: 非部位性症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 接觸灰塵、花粉、冷空氣誘發提示過敏性；受涼後新發提示外感風寒初起
晨起陣發性噴嚏提示過敏性鼻炎；季節性發作提示花粉相關
鼻塞流清涕、目癢提示過敏；發熱、呼吸困難需另外評估

inquiry_en.why: Triggered by dust, pollen or cold air suggests an allergic cause; new onset after cold exposure suggests early wind-cold contraction
Paroxysmal sneezing on waking suggests allergic rhinitis; seasonal onset suggests pollen-related triggers
Nasal congestion with clear discharge and itchy eyes suggest allergy; fever or breathing difficulty warrant separate evaluation

differentiation_zh.variant: 噴嚏頻作，遇風冷即發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 噴嚏連連，鼻塞流清涕，惡寒發熱，遇風冷加重，舌苔薄白

differentiation_zh.variant: 晨起陣發噴嚏，反覆難癒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 晨起或遇冷風即陣發噴嚏，鼻流清涕，平素易感冒，氣短自汗

differentiation_en.variant: Frequent sneezing triggered by wind-cold
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Repeated sneezing, nasal congestion with clear discharge, aversion to cold with fever, worse with wind/cold exposure, thin white tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Recurrent paroxysmal sneezing on waking
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Paroxysmal sneezing on waking or with cold wind, clear nasal discharge, frequent colds, shortness of breath and spontaneous sweating

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, "Sneezing", https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003060.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11 — states sneezing is rarely a sign of a serious problem
sources: MedlinePlus, Sneezing (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003060.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 鼻鼽相關噴嚏辨證內容

field_sources.safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus explicitly frames isolated sneezing as rarely serious (2026-08-11 retrieved); genuine red-flag content belongs to accompanying fever/dyspnea, not sneezing itself

records.definition_zh: 面部膚色晦暗、缺乏光澤，非蒼白（血虛/貧血的白）亦非黃疸（真性黃染），是望診中最常被病人或醫者留意到的整體氣色改變。西醫無專屬病名，多視為貧血、肝病或甲狀腺功能低下等疾病的伴隨表現。
records.definition_en: A dull, lusterless facial skin tone lacking healthy brightness — distinguished from frank pallor (whiteness from reduced perfusion or anemia) and true jaundice (yellowing from bilirubin). Biomedicine has no dedicated diagnostic term for it; it is generally noted as an accompanying sign of anemia, liver disease, or hypothyroidism.
records.patient_words_zh: 「氣色不好，人家常問我是不是沒睡好」「臉黃黃的，沒有光澤」「照鏡子覺得臉很暗沉」
records.patient_words_en: "I look tired all the time, people keep asking if I've been sleeping", "my face looks sallow, no glow to it", "my complexion looks dull in the mirror"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

laterality.why: 面部整體性改變，不分側

inquiry_zh.why: 兼乏力、心悸、頭暈提示血虛／貧血；兼鞏膜黃染、尿色深提示肝膽病變；兼怕冷、體重增加提示甲狀腺功能低下
逐漸出現與短期內明顯變化，鑑別方向不同——後者更需優先排查器質性病變
產後、經量過多、長期飲食失調等病史提示血虛病機

inquiry_en.why: With fatigue, palpitations and dizziness suggests blood deficiency/anaemia; with scleral yellowing and dark urine suggests hepatobiliary disease; with cold intolerance and weight gain suggests hypothyroidism
Gradual onset versus a marked recent change point in different directions — the latter warrants prompt evaluation for organic disease
A history of postpartum blood loss, heavy menstrual bleeding, or long-standing poor diet suggests a blood-deficiency mechanism

differentiation_zh.variant: 面色萎黃兼乏力心悸
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 面色萎黃無華，兼頭暈眼花、心悸、爪甲色淡、月經量少色淡

differentiation_zh.variant: 面色無華兼食少便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 面色萎黃，兼食少納呆、腹脹便溏、倦怠乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 面色晦暗兼畏寒肢冷
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 面色晦暗無華，兼畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠軟、夜尿頻多

differentiation_en.variant: Sallow complexion with fatigue and palpitations
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sallow lusterless complexion with dizziness, palpitations, pale nail beds, scanty pale menstruation

differentiation_en.variant: Sallow complexion with poor appetite and loose stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sallow complexion with poor appetite, abdominal distension, loose stool, fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Dusky dull complexion with cold intolerance
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dusky lusterless complexion with cold intolerance and cold limbs, weak aching low back and knees, frequent night urination

safety_review_sources: NHS, "Iron deficiency anaemia", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/iron-deficiency-anaemia/, retrieved 2026-08-11 — the term "sallow" itself is not a formally defined biomedical sign; red flags below reflect the anaemia/liver/thyroid associations documented at this source, not a dedicated "sallow complexion" clinical guideline
red_flags_zh: 面色無華合併真性黃疸（鞏膜／皮膚黃染）、深色尿液或淺色糞便 → 提示肝膽病變，需儘速評估
合併明顯疲倦、呼吸急促、心悸 → 提示貧血，需檢查
合併不明原因體重減輕、腹部腫脹或意識混亂
合併怕冷、體重增加、皮膚乾燥 → 提示甲狀腺功能低下
red_flags_en: Sallow complexion together with true jaundice (yellowing of sclera/skin), dark urine, or pale stools → suggests liver disease, evaluate promptly
Together with marked fatigue, shortness of breath, palpitations → suggests anaemia, warrants testing
Together with unexplained weight loss, abdominal swelling, or confusion
Together with cold intolerance, weight gain, dry skin → suggests hypothyroidism
sources: NHS, Iron deficiency anaemia (https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/iron-deficiency-anaemia/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫望診 面色理論 —— 中醫診斷學 望色章節

field_sources.safety_review_sources: NHS anaemia page confirms pallor/fatigue linkage; "sallow" itself has no dedicated biomedical source found — flagged honestly rather than inventing one (weakest-sourced red flag set in this batch)

records.definition_zh: 因神經或肌肉病變導致唇、舌、下頜、聲帶或呼吸肌協調不良，說話含糊不清、吐字不清，西醫稱構音障礙（dysarthria），與失語症（語言功能受損）不同。是主訴／體徵，突發者需視為中風徵象立即評估。
records.definition_en: A motor speech disorder in which weakness or incoordination of the lips, tongue, jaw, vocal cords, or breathing muscles produces slurred, imprecise or difficult-to-understand speech — termed dysarthria in biomedicine, distinct from aphasia (a language-processing disorder). Sudden onset must be treated as a possible stroke sign requiring immediate evaluation.
records.patient_words_zh: 「講話變得含糊」「舌頭不聽使喚」「家人說我講話怪怪的」「咬字咬不清楚」
records.patient_words_en: "My speech has gone slurry", "my tongue doesn't do what I want", "my family says I sound different when I talk", "I can't enunciate clearly"

location.why: 非部位性症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 常與同側／對側肢體無力併見，側性有定位意義

inquiry_zh.why: 突發者需視為中風，立即啟動紅旗流程；緩慢進行性者需考慮神經退化性疾病
合併一側面部下垂、單側肢體無力、意識改變 → 立即就醫；合併吞嚥困難需評估誤吸風險
中風病史、糖尿病、高血壓等血管危險因子提示相關風險

inquiry_en.why: Sudden onset must be treated as stroke and enter the red-flag pathway immediately; slow progressive onset suggests a neurodegenerative process
One-sided facial droop, one-sided limb weakness, or altered consciousness → seek care immediately; accompanying swallowing difficulty raises aspiration risk
A history of stroke, diabetes, or hypertension flags vascular risk

differentiation_zh.variant: 言語謇澀突發，兼半身不遂
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 言語謇澀或不語，突然發作，兼半身不遂、口眼喎斜，多見於中風

differentiation_zh.variant: 言語謇澀漸進，兼肢體震顫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 言語漸漸含糊，動作遲緩，兼肢體震顫、行走不穩，緩慢進行

differentiation_zh.variant: 言語謇澀兼痰多神呆
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 言語不清，喉間痰鳴，神情呆滯，肢體麻木

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden slurred speech with hemiplegia
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden slurred or absent speech with hemiplegia and facial deviation, typical of stroke

differentiation_en.variant: Gradually worsening slurred speech with tremor
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Gradually worsening slurred speech, slowed movement, limb tremor, unsteady gait, slowly progressive

differentiation_en.variant: Slurred speech with copious phlegm and dullness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Slurred speech, rattling phlegm sounds in the throat, dull mental affect, limb numbness

safety_review_sources: Cleveland Clinic, "Dysarthria (Slurred Speech): Symptoms, Causes & Treatment", https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/17653-dysarthria, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 突發言語含糊 → 視為中風可能，立即就醫
合併一側臉部下垂
合併一側手臂或肢體無力，或雙臂上舉時單側下垂
合併突發意識混亂、視力改變或劇烈頭痛
合併肢體協調喪失或步態不穩
合併吞嚥困難、反覆嗆咳，有吸入性肺炎風險
red_flags_en: Sudden onset of slurred speech → treat as possible stroke, seek care immediately
Accompanying one-sided facial drooping
Accompanying one-sided arm/limb weakness, or one arm drifting down when both are raised
Accompanying sudden confusion, vision changes, or severe headache
Accompanying sudden loss of coordination or unsteady gait
Accompanying swallowing difficulty or repeated coughing, raising aspiration pneumonia risk
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Dysarthria (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/17653-dysarthria, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 中風／言語謇澀辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Dysarthria, referencing American Stroke Association F.A.S.T. framework (retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 呼吸時喉間或胸中發出的異常聲響，不需聽診器即可聞及。西醫依部位再分為哮鳴音（wheeze，下呼吸道，呼氣時明顯）與喘鳴（stridor，上呼吸道／喉部，吸氣時明顯），中醫統稱喉中痰鳴或哮鳴，責之痰阻氣道。
records.definition_en: An abnormal sound heard during breathing, audible without a stethoscope. Biomedicine distinguishes it by airway location — wheeze (lower airway, musical, usually on exhale) versus stridor (upper airway/throat, harsh, usually on inhale) — while TCM groups both under phlegm obstructing the airway.
records.patient_words_zh: 「喘的時候喉嚨會咻咻叫」「呼吸有痰音，像拉風箱」「一咳就有咕嚕咕嚕的聲音」
records.patient_words_en: "My throat whistles when I breathe hard", "my breathing sounds rattly, like bellows", "there's a gurgling sound whenever I cough"

location.why: 非部位性症狀（喉／胸腔整體聲響）

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 首次發作、無法解釋的喘鳴需儘速評估；接觸過敏原或蟲咬後發作提示過敏反應
明顯呼吸困難、嘴唇發紺、意識改變、無法言語或飲水 → 立即就醫；靜息時喘鳴、合併流口水、快速惡化提示急症
反覆發作而無明確誘因，需要進一步檢查

inquiry_en.why: A first-ever or unexplained episode needs prompt evaluation; onset after an insect sting or medication suggests possible anaphylaxis
Significant breathlessness, blue lips/skin, confusion, or inability to speak or drink normally → seek emergency care; stridor at rest with drooling and rapid worsening suggests an emergency
Recurrent episodes without a clear trigger warrant further workup

differentiation_zh.variant: 喉中哮鳴，痰白清稀
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 喉中哮鳴如水雞聲，痰白清稀量多，畏寒肢冷，遇冷加重

differentiation_zh.variant: 喉中哮鳴，痰黃黏稠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 喉中哮鳴聲高，痰黃黏稠難咯，發熱口渴，面赤

differentiation_en.variant: Wheeze with thin white phlegm
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Wheeze like a frog's croak, copious thin white phlegm, aversion to cold with cold limbs, worse with cold exposure

differentiation_en.variant: Wheeze with thick yellow phlegm
differentiation_en.distinguishing: High-pitched wheeze, thick sticky yellow phlegm difficult to expectorate, fever and thirst, flushed face

red_flags_zh: 首次發作或無法解釋的喘鳴／哮鳴（尤其兒童）需儘速評估
合併明顯呼吸困難、嘴唇或皮膚發紺、意識混亂
靜息時仍有喘鳴、迅速惡化，或合併流口水、無法正常言語進食 → 視為急症
使用胸／頸部輔助肌呼吸（凹陷）
因蟲咬或藥物誘發的喘鳴 → 需排除過敏性休克
反覆發作而無明確誘因
red_flags_en: First-ever episode or unexplained wheeze/stridor (especially in a child) needs prompt evaluation
Accompanying significant breathlessness, blue lips/skin, or confusion
Stridor at rest, rapidly worsening, or with drooling and inability to speak/drink normally → treat as an emergency
Use of chest/neck accessory muscles to breathe (retractions)
Wheeze triggered by an insect sting or medication → rule out anaphylaxis
Recurrent wheeze without a clear explanation
sources: MedlinePlus, Wheezing (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003070.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11)
MedlinePlus, Stridor (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003074.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 哮證／喘證辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: MedlinePlus Wheezing + Stridor (both retrieved 2026-08-11) — biomedicine splits by airway location, TCM groups both under one term; card notes the split

records.definition_zh: 肢體或關節活動時感覺僵滯、不靈活，屈伸受限，非急性外傷所致。西醫依機轉分兩類：關節炎性晨僵（如類風濕關節炎）與帕金森氏症的肌強直（cogwheel/lead-pipe rigidity），兩者鑑別要點不同。
records.definition_en: A sense of stiffness or restricted range of motion in a limb or joint during movement, not from acute injury. Biomedicine recognises two distinct mechanisms mapping to this one complaint: inflammatory morning joint stiffness (as in rheumatoid arthritis) and Parkinsonian rigidity (cogwheel/lead-pipe stiffness) — the two are distinguished by different clinical features.
records.patient_words_zh: 「早上起來手指僵僵的，動一動才鬆開」「關節卡卡的，不靈活」「身體變得僵硬，動作變慢」
records.patient_words_en: "My fingers feel stiff in the morning, they loosen up once I move them", "my joints feel stuck, not flexible", "my body's gotten stiff and my movements have slowed"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 酸屬虛濕 · 冷屬寒凝

timing.diagnostic_note_zh: 晨起僵硬、活動後緩解提示發炎性關節病變；持續性僵硬提示帕金森氏症肌強直

inquiry_zh.why: 晨僵持續 30-60 分鐘以上、活動後緩解，提示發炎性關節炎（如類風濕）而非單純退化性關節炎
小關節（手指、腕）對稱性僵硬提示發炎性關節病；全身性僵硬、伴動作遲緩提示帕金森氏症
合併關節腫脹、發熱、發紅、觸痛 → 需就醫；合併明顯疲倦、發熱或體重減輕；合併面部表情減少、手臂擺動減少提示帕金森氏症
持續超過六週的僵硬需要進一步檢查

inquiry_en.why: Morning stiffness lasting 30-60+ minutes that eases with activity suggests inflammatory arthritis (e.g. RA) rather than simple degenerative joint disease
Symmetric small-joint (finger, wrist) stiffness suggests inflammatory arthropathy; generalised stiffness with slowed movement suggests parkinsonism
Joint swelling, warmth, redness or tenderness → see a doctor; marked fatigue, fever, or weight loss; reduced facial expression and reduced arm swing suggest parkinsonism
Stiffness persisting beyond six weeks warrants further investigation

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體僵硬冷痛，遇寒加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體關節僵硬冷痛，屈伸不利，遇寒加重，得溫則舒

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體僵硬灼熱，關節紅腫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體關節僵硬，兼紅腫灼熱疼痛，得冷則舒，或有發熱

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體僵硬遲緩，兼震顫
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體僵硬，活動遲緩，兼靜止性震顫、表情呆滯，緩慢進行

differentiation_en.variant: Cold, painful stiffness worse with cold exposure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cold, painful joint stiffness with restricted movement, worse with cold exposure, better with warmth

differentiation_en.variant: Hot, swollen stiffness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Joint stiffness with redness, swelling and burning pain, relieved by cold, sometimes with fever

differentiation_en.variant: Rigid slowed movement with tremor
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Limb rigidity with slowed movement, resting tremor, blank facial expression, slowly progressive

red_flags_zh: 晨僵持續超過 30-60 分鐘，尤其手腕、手指等小關節，活動後緩解 → 提示發炎性關節炎，需風濕科評估
關節僵硬合併腫脹、發熱、發紅或觸痛
僵硬合併不明原因疲倦、發熱或體重減輕
肢體僵硬合併動作遲緩、手臂擺動減少、面部表情減少 → 提示帕金森氏症，需神經科評估
步態明顯惡化或跌倒頻率增加
red_flags_en: Morning stiffness lasting 30-60+ minutes, especially in small joints like fingers/wrists, easing with activity → suggests inflammatory arthritis, warrants rheumatology assessment
Joint stiffness with swelling, warmth, redness or tenderness
Stiffness with unexplained fatigue, fever, or weight loss
Limb rigidity with slowed movement, reduced arm swing, and reduced facial expression → suggests parkinsonism, warrants neurology assessment
Markedly worsening gait or increasing fall frequency
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Parkinsonism (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/22815-parkinsonism, retrieved 2026-08-11)
Parkinson's Foundation, Rigidity (https://www.parkinson.org/understanding-parkinsons/movement-symptoms/rigidity, retrieved 2026-08-11)
NHS, Rheumatoid arthritis - Symptoms (https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/rheumatoid-arthritis/symptoms/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 痹證／顫證辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic + Parkinson's Foundation (rigidity) and NHS RA symptoms page (morning stiffness duration), all directly fetched 2026-08-11 — replaces an earlier unverified Mayo Clinic citation

records.definition_zh: 大量出汗且皮膚觸之濕冷、蒼白，非因熱或運動所致，西醫稱冷汗（diaphoresis with cold clammy skin），常見於休克、心肌梗塞、低血糖等急重症的伴隨表現，中醫多屬陽氣暴脫的危候。
records.definition_en: Profuse sweating with skin that is cold, clammy and pale to the touch, not from heat or exertion — termed diaphoresis with cold clammy skin in biomedicine, classically accompanying shock, myocardial infarction, hypoglycemia and other acute severe conditions. In TCM it is often a sign of sudden Yang qi collapse.
records.patient_words_zh: 「突然冒冷汗，全身濕透」「手腳冰冷還一直流汗」「臉色發白，冷汗直流」
records.patient_words_en: "Suddenly broke out in a cold sweat, soaked through", "my hands and feet are cold but I'm still sweating", "went pale and started pouring cold sweat"

location.why: 全身性症狀，非局部部位

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

timing.why: 多為急性發作，非週期性

inquiry_zh.why: 合併胸痛胸悶提示心肌梗塞可能；合併頭暈或意識喪失；合併噁心嘔吐與皮膚濕冷蒼白；合併呼吸困難需立即就醫
突然發作且伴隨其他急症徵象，須視為危急狀況立即處理，不可拖延觀察
劇痛、極度恐懼、低血糖、失血後發作，各指向不同機轉

inquiry_en.why: With chest pain/pressure or palpitations suggests possible heart attack; with dizziness or loss of consciousness; with nausea/vomiting and cold clammy pale skin; with difficulty breathing → seek care immediately
Sudden onset with other acute warning signs must be treated as an emergency, not observed and waited out
Onset with severe pain, extreme fear, hypoglycemia, or blood loss each points to a different mechanism

differentiation_zh.variant: 冷汗淋漓，肢冷脈微
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 冷汗淋漓不止，四肢厥冷，面色蒼白，脈微欲絕，屬陽氣暴脫危候

differentiation_zh.variant: 冷汗淋漓，兼胸痛胸悶
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 冷汗突然出現，兼胸痛徹背、胸悶如窒，唇甲青紫

differentiation_en.variant: Profuse cold sweat with cold limbs and faint pulse
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Unrelenting cold sweat, cold extremities, pale complexion, faint thready pulse verging on imperceptible — a sign of sudden Yang qi collapse

differentiation_en.variant: Cold sweat with chest pain and tightness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden cold sweat with chest pain radiating to the back, oppressive chest tightness, cyanotic lips and nails

red_flags_zh: 冷汗合併胸痛或胸悶、心悸 → 視為可能心肌梗塞，立即就醫
冷汗合併頭暈或意識喪失（暈厥）
冷汗合併噁心嘔吐，且皮膚濕冷蒼白
冷汗合併呼吸困難
冷汗合併癲癇發作
冷汗合併四肢冰冷斑駁、呼吸急促、寒顫或意識混亂 → 需排除敗血症
red_flags_en: Cold sweat with chest pain/pressure or palpitations → treat as possible heart attack, call emergency services
Cold sweat with dizziness or loss of consciousness (fainting)
Cold sweat with nausea/vomiting plus cold, clammy, or pale skin
Cold sweat with difficulty breathing
Cold sweat with seizures
Cold sweat with pale/blotchy cold limbs, rapid breathing, chills, or confusion → rule out sepsis
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Diaphoresis (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/24496-diaphoresis, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 亡陽／脫證相關冷汗辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Diaphoresis (retrieved 2026-08-11)

aliases_en: Sense of blockage in the upper abdomen
records.definition_zh: 上腹部（胃脘）自覺脹悶、堵塞感，按之柔軟不痛，與腹脹（脹在全腹或下腹）、胃脘痛（以痛為主）不同。西醫多對應功能性消化不良（餐後不適症候群），需先排除器質性病因。
records.definition_en: A subjective sense of fullness or blockage in the upper abdomen (epigastrium), soft and non-tender on palpation — distinct from generalized/lower abdominal bloating and from epigastric pain where pain is the leading feature. Biomedicine generally maps this to functional dyspepsia (postprandial distress subtype), which first requires excluding structural disease.
records.patient_words_zh: 「胃這邊悶悶脹脹的，不算痛」「吃一點就覺得撐」「胃裡好像堵住了」
records.patient_words_en: "It feels stuffy and full right here in my stomach, not really painful", "I feel full after just a few bites", "my stomach feels blocked up"

inquiry_zh.why: 食後加重提示食積或脾胃虛弱；情緒波動誘發提示肝胃不和
按之柔軟、無壓痛屬痞滿；若拒按有壓痛則需重新考慮是否為胃脘痛
合併不明原因體重減輕、吞嚥困難或疼痛、不明原因貧血、持續嘔吐、可觸及腫塊，需儘速轉診胃鏡檢查
症狀持續三個月以上、六個月前即已出現，符合功能性消化不良的時間框架

inquiry_en.why: Worse after eating suggests food stagnation or Spleen-Stomach deficiency; triggered by emotional upset suggests Liver-Stomach disharmony
Soft and non-tender on palpation is typical of fullness; tenderness on palpation should prompt reconsidering epigastric pain instead
Unintentional weight loss, dysphagia or odynophagia, unexplained anemia, persistent vomiting, or a palpable mass warrant prompt referral for endoscopy
Symptoms present for 3+ months with onset 6+ months earlier fit the functional dyspepsia time frame

differentiation_zh.variant: 痞滿食後加重，噯腐吞酸
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 脘腹痞滿，食後加重，噯氣酸腐，不思飲食，或吐不消化食物

differentiation_zh.variant: 痞滿隱隱，食少倦怠
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘痞滿，時輕時重，喜按，食少納呆，神疲乏力，大便溏薄

differentiation_zh.variant: 痞滿脹悶，因情緒誘發
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 胃脘痞滿，兩脅脹悶，因情志不遂而發作或加重，噯氣頻作

differentiation_en.variant: Fullness worse after eating, with sour belching
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Epigastric fullness worse after eating, sour rotten belching, poor appetite, occasionally vomiting undigested food

differentiation_en.variant: Vague fullness with poor appetite and fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Epigastric fullness that waxes and wanes, better with pressure, poor appetite, fatigue, loose stool

differentiation_en.variant: Fullness triggered by emotional upset
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Epigastric fullness with rib-side distension, worse with emotional frustration, frequent belching

red_flags_zh: 合併不明原因體重減輕
合併吞嚥困難（dysphagia）或吞嚥疼痛（odynophagia）
合併不明原因缺鐵性貧血
合併持續嘔吐
上腹可觸及腫塊或淋巴結腫大
有上消化道癌症家族史，或年齡 60 歲以上——依指引建議常規安排胃鏡，不論是否有警示症狀
red_flags_en: Accompanying unintentional weight loss
Accompanying difficulty swallowing (dysphagia) or painful swallowing (odynophagia)
Accompanying unexplained iron-deficiency anemia
Accompanying persistent vomiting
A palpable epigastric mass or lymphadenopathy
Family history of upper GI cancer, or age 60+ — guidance recommends endoscopy regardless of alarm symptoms
sources: StatPearls, Functional Dyspepsia (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK554563/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 痞滿辨證分型（食滯／脾虛／肝胃不和）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Functional Dyspepsia, Rome IV alarm features (retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 身體一側（面、臂、腿）的癱瘓或無力，多因腦部或脊髓病變所致，西醫稱偏癱（hemiplegia）或偏輕癱（hemiparesis）。突然發生者幾乎都是急症，需視為中風處理直至排除。
records.definition_en: Paralysis or weakness affecting only one side of the body — face, arm and/or leg — usually from a brain or spinal cord lesion. Sudden onset is almost always a medical emergency and must be treated as stroke until ruled out.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一邊手腳突然沒力氣」「一側身體麻痺、抬不起來」「走路一邊拖著腳」
records.patient_words_en: "One side of my arm and leg suddenly went weak", "one side of my body is numb, I can't lift it", "I'm dragging one foot when I walk"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 突然發作幾乎都是急症，須立即啟動中風流程；緩慢漸進者需考慮其他神經系統病變
合併言語謇澀、口眼喎斜、意識改變、視力改變、平衡失調 → 立即就醫
面、臂、腿受累程度與範圍協助定位病灶

inquiry_en.why: Sudden onset is almost always an emergency requiring the stroke pathway; gradual onset suggests a different neurological process
Slurred speech, facial deviation, altered consciousness, vision change, or loss of balance → seek care immediately
The extent of face/arm/leg involvement helps localise the lesion

differentiation_zh.variant: 半身不遂突發，兼神昏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 半身不遂突然發作，兼神志昏蒙、口眼喎斜、言語謇澀，多見於中風中臟腑

differentiation_zh.variant: 半身不遂，兼肢體麻木
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 半身不遂，肢體麻木不仁，舌質紫暗或有瘀斑，病程較久

differentiation_zh.variant: 半身不遂，兼氣短乏力
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 半身不遂日久不復，兼氣短乏力、自汗、面色萎黃，屬中風後氣虛血瘀

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden hemiplegia with impaired consciousness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden-onset hemiplegia with clouded consciousness, facial deviation and slurred speech, typical of stroke affecting the organs

differentiation_en.variant: Hemiplegia with limb numbness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hemiplegia with numbness, dusky or ecchymotic tongue, longer disease course

differentiation_en.variant: Hemiplegia with shortness of breath and fatigue
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Hemiplegia persisting without recovery, with shortness of breath, fatigue, spontaneous sweating, sallow complexion — typical of post-stroke qi deficiency with blood stasis

safety_review_sources: American Stroke Association, "Stroke Symptoms and Warning Signs" — corroborated via indexed search excerpts of https://www.stroke.org/en/about-stroke/stroke-symptoms (direct fetch blocked by site bot-protection, HTTP 403); B.E. F.A.S.T. content consistent across independent search results but not independently confirmed by direct page render
red_flags_zh: 突然發生一側臉部、手臂或腿部無力 → 視為中風，立即撥打急救電話
一側臉部下垂，或笑起來不對稱
雙臂上舉時一側手臂下垂
合併言語含糊或說話困難
突然失去平衡或協調能力，或突然視力改變
半身不遂幾乎都是需要儘速就醫評估的徵象
red_flags_en: Sudden onset of one-sided face/arm/leg weakness → treat as stroke, call emergency services immediately
Face drooping on one side, or an uneven smile
One arm drifting downward when both are raised
Accompanying slurred or difficult speech
Sudden loss of balance/coordination, or sudden vision changes
Hemiplegia is almost always a reason to seek care as soon as possible
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Hemiplegia (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/23542-hemiplegia, retrieved 2026-08-11)
American Stroke Association B.E. F.A.S.T. — sourced via search index, direct fetch blocked (2026-08-11), needs manual verification
中醫內科學 中風／半身不遂辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Hemiplegia (directly fetched) + ASA stroke warning signs (search-index sourced only, flagged for manual verification, 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 一側面部肌肉無力，導致口角、眼裂不對稱或下垂。西醫鑑別兩大機轉：周邊性（第七對腦神經病變，如貝爾氏麻痺，前額肌肉同側受累）與中樞性（腦血管病變，前額肌肉因雙側皮質支配而不受影響）——前額是否受累是床邊鑑別要點。
records.definition_en: One-sided facial muscle weakness causing asymmetry or drooping of the mouth corner and eye. Biomedicine distinguishes two mechanisms: peripheral (facial/cranial nerve VII lesion, e.g. Bell's palsy — the forehead on the weak side is also affected) versus central (stroke — the forehead is spared due to bilateral cortical innervation). Whether the forehead is affected is the key bedside distinguishing sign.
records.patient_words_zh: 「一邊嘴角垂下來」「照鏡子發現臉歪了」「一邊眼睛閉不緊」「喝水會從嘴角漏出來」
records.patient_words_en: "One side of my mouth is drooping", "I noticed my face looks crooked in the mirror", "I can't close one eye all the way", "water dribbles out of one side of my mouth when I drink"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 前額是否同側受累（皺眉、抬眉是否對稱）是鑑別周邊性（貝爾氏麻痺）與中樞性（中風）的床邊要點
突然發生須立即視為可能中風；醫療指引明確指出不應自行判斷是貝爾氏麻痺還是中風，一律儘速就醫
合併言語喪失、單側肢體無力、失去平衡、視力改變、劇烈頭痛、頸部僵硬、抽搐、突發記憶喪失或人格改變 → 立即撥打急救電話

inquiry_en.why: Whether the forehead on the same side is affected (symmetric brow-raise or not) is the key bedside distinguisher between peripheral (Bell's palsy) and central (stroke) causes
Sudden onset must be treated as possible stroke immediately; guidance explicitly advises against self-distinguishing Bell's palsy from stroke — seek care right away regardless
Loss of speech, one-sided limb weakness, loss of balance, vision changes, severe headache, neck stiffness, seizures, sudden memory loss or personality change → call emergency services immediately

differentiation_zh.variant: 口眼喎斜突發，前額受累
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 突然口角歪斜，患側額紋消失、眼裂變大、鼓腮漏氣，多因風邪中絡，即周邊性面癱

differentiation_zh.variant: 口眼喎斜，兼半身不遂
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 口眼喎斜伴半身不遂、言語謇澀，患側額紋不消失（前額不受累），多屬中風中經絡

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden facial droop with forehead involvement
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden facial droop with loss of forehead wrinkles on the affected side, widened palpebral fissure, air leaking when puffing the cheeks — typically wind invading the channel, i.e. peripheral facial palsy

differentiation_en.variant: Facial droop with hemiplegia
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Facial droop with hemiplegia and slurred speech, forehead wrinkles preserved on the affected side (forehead spared) — typically stroke affecting the channels

safety_review_sources: American Stroke Association B.E. F.A.S.T. materials — corroborated via indexed search excerpts of https://www.stroke.org/en/help-and-support/resource-library/be-fast-materials/be-fast-infographic (direct fetch blocked, HTTP 403); not independently confirmed by direct page render
red_flags_zh: 突然出現面部下垂 → 視為中風可能，立即就醫（醫療指引明確不建議自行分辨是貝爾氏麻痺或中風）
合併言語喪失（失語）
合併突發視力喪失或複視
合併突發平衡或協調喪失
合併劇烈頭痛、頸部僵硬、噁心嘔吐
合併抽搐、突發記憶喪失或人格／情緒改變
合併視覺、聽覺、嗅覺、味覺或觸覺任何一種突然喪失
red_flags_en: Facial drooping appearing suddenly → treat as possible stroke, seek care immediately (guidance explicitly advises against trying to self-distinguish Bell's palsy from stroke)
Accompanying loss of speech (aphasia)
Accompanying sudden vision loss or double vision
Accompanying sudden loss of balance/coordination
Accompanying sudden severe headache, neck stiffness, nausea/vomiting
Accompanying seizures, sudden memory loss, or personality/emotional change
Sudden loss of any sense (vision, hearing, smell, taste, touch) alongside the facial asymmetry
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Bell's Palsy (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/5457-bells-palsy, retrieved 2026-08-11)
American Stroke Association B.E. F.A.S.T. materials — sourced via search index, direct fetch blocked (2026-08-11), needs manual verification
中醫內科學 面癱／中風辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Bell's Palsy (directly fetched) + ASA B.E. F.A.S.T. (search-index sourced only, flagged, 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 病人清醒度（意識水平）或認知內容（定向感、思考、語言）較平時發生改變，西醫稱意識狀態改變（altered mental status），是主訴／體徵而非診斷，需儘速找出病因。
records.definition_en: A change from a person's baseline arousal (wakefulness/alertness) and/or cognitive content (orientation, thought, language) — termed altered mental status in biomedicine. A presenting symptom/sign, not a diagnosis, that requires prompt evaluation to identify the underlying cause.
records.patient_words_zh: （多由家屬代述）「叫他都沒反應」「講話語無倫次」「突然變得很奇怪，認不得人」「昏昏沉沉叫不太醒」
records.patient_words_en: (often reported by family) "He's not responding when we call him", "her speech isn't making sense", "he suddenly seemed strange, didn't recognize people", "she's drowsy and hard to rouse"

location.why: 非部位性症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

timing.why: 多為急性發作，非週期性

severity.why: 實例值（如 GCS 分數），屬病例層

inquiry_zh.why: 突發者需優先排除中風、代謝異常、中毒等急症；緩慢進行者需考慮神經退化性疾病
合併一側肢體無力、言語障礙、劇烈頭痛提示中風；合併高熱、頸部僵硬提示腦膜炎；合併抽搐、胸痛、呼吸困難需立即處理
頭部外傷、藥物或毒物接觸史、糖尿病病史（低血糖）、感染徵象等提供病因線索

inquiry_en.why: Sudden onset should prompt ruling out stroke, metabolic disturbance, or poisoning first; gradual onset suggests a neurodegenerative process
One-sided weakness, speech difficulty, severe headache suggest stroke; high fever with neck stiffness suggests meningitis; seizures, chest pain, or breathing difficulty require immediate management
Head trauma, drug/toxin exposure, a history of diabetes (hypoglycemia), or signs of infection provide etiological clues

differentiation_zh.variant: 神志昏蒙，兼半身不遂、口眼喎斜
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 突然神志昏蒙不清，兼半身不遂、口眼喎斜、言語謇澀，多見於中風中臟腑

differentiation_zh.variant: 神志昏蒙，兼痰壅氣粗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 神志昏蒙，喉間痰聲漉漉，呼吸氣粗，肢體不溫

differentiation_zh.variant: 神志昏蒙，高熱煩躁
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 神志昏蒙譫語，高熱煩躁，甚則抽搐，舌紅絳

differentiation_en.variant: Clouded consciousness with hemiplegia and facial deviation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden clouded/impaired consciousness with hemiplegia, facial deviation and slurred speech, typical of stroke affecting the organs

differentiation_en.variant: Clouded consciousness with phlegm-blocked breathing
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Clouded consciousness with rattling phlegm sounds in the throat, coarse breathing, cold limbs

differentiation_en.variant: Clouded consciousness with high fever and agitation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Clouded consciousness with delirious speech, high fever and agitation, sometimes convulsions, deep red tongue

safety_review_sources: StatPearls/NCBI Bookshelf, "Change in Mental Status", https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK441973/, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 突然意識混亂合併一側肢體無力、言語含糊或劇烈頭痛 → 立即就醫（排除中風）
意識改變合併高燒與頸部僵硬（排除腦膜炎）
意識改變合併抽搐、胸痛或呼吸困難
無法喚醒、不能保護呼吸道（如喪失嘔吐反射）→ 需緊急呼吸道處置
出現單側瞳孔放大且對光無反應，或血壓上升合併心跳變慢（庫欣氏反應）→ 提示腦疝迫近
突然定向力喪失、注意力渙散、行為異常（譫妄）本身即為醫療急症
red_flags_en: Sudden confusion plus one-sided weakness, slurred speech, or severe headache → seek care immediately (rule out stroke)
Altered mental status with high fever and stiff neck (rule out meningitis)
Altered mental status with seizures, chest pain, or trouble breathing
Cannot be roused, or cannot protect the airway (e.g. absent gag reflex) → emergency airway management needed
A unilateral dilated, non-reactive pupil, or rising blood pressure with falling heart rate (Cushing reflex) → suggests impending brain herniation
Sudden disorientation, distractibility, or unusual behaviour (delirium) is itself considered a medical emergency
sources: StatPearls, Change in Mental Status (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK441973/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
Cleveland Clinic, Altered Mental Status (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/23159-altered-mental-status-ams, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 神昏／中風中臟腑辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Change in Mental Status + Cleveland Clinic AMS (both retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 皮膚、黏膜及鞏膜因膽紅素蓪積而呈現黃色，西醫稱黃疸（jaundice/icterus），機轉分肝細胞性、膽道阻塞性與溶血性三大類。中西醫在此症狀上是同一觀察，命名幾乎完全重疊。
records.definition_en: Yellow discoloration of the skin, mucous membranes and sclera caused by bilirubin accumulation — termed jaundice/icterus in biomedicine, classified as hepatocellular, biliary-obstructive, or hemolytic in mechanism. TCM and biomedicine name this exact same observation almost identically.
records.patient_words_zh: 「眼白變黃了」「皮膚變黃，尿也變深」「家人說我臉色發黃」
records.patient_words_en: "The whites of my eyes turned yellow", "my skin's gone yellow, and my urine's darker too", "my family said my face looks yellow"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

severity.why: 實例值（如膽紅素數值），屬病例層

inquiry_zh.why: 合併意識混亂、定向力障礙提示肝性腦病；合併發熱、右上腹痛（夏科氏三聯徵）提示急性膽管炎；合併皮膚搔癢、深色尿、淺色糞便提示膽道阻塞
近期用藥史、飲酒史、病毒性肝炎接觸史、膽結石病史提供病因線索
急性快速加重（尤其合併發熱腹痛）須視為急症；慢性緩慢出現者仍需完整評估

inquiry_en.why: Confusion or disorientation suggests hepatic encephalopathy; fever with right-upper-quadrant pain (Charcot's triad) suggests acute cholangitis; itching, dark urine and pale stools suggest biliary obstruction
Recent medication use, alcohol history, viral hepatitis exposure, or a history of gallstones provides etiological clues
Rapid worsening (especially with fever and abdominal pain) must be treated as an emergency; gradual chronic onset still needs full evaluation

differentiation_zh.variant: 黃疸鮮明如橘，兼發熱脅痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 身目俱黃，色鮮明如橘皮，兼發熱、脅痛、口苦、小便黃赤，舌苔黃膩

differentiation_zh.variant: 黃疸晦暗如煙燻，兼畏寒
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 身目俱黃，色晦暗如煙燻，兼脘腹脹悶、畏寒肢冷、大便溏薄，屬陰黃

differentiation_en.variant: Bright orange-yellow jaundice with fever and hypochondriac pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bright, orange-peel-like jaundice of skin and eyes with fever, hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, dark urine, yellow greasy tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Dull, smoky jaundice with cold intolerance
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dull, smoky-yellow discoloration of skin and eyes with epigastric fullness, cold intolerance and cold limbs, loose stool — a "yin jaundice" pattern

red_flags_zh: 黃疸合併意識混亂、定向力障礙 → 提示肝性腦病，屬醫療急症
黃疸合併發熱與右上腹痛（夏科氏三聯徵）→ 提示急性膽管炎，須緊急抗生素與膽道引流
任何皮膚或眼白發黃都應儘速就醫評估
合併皮膚搔癢、深色尿液、淺色（陶土狀）糞便 → 提示膽道阻塞
既有肝病病史者，黃疸加重、腹部腫脹（腹水）或新發發熱 → 須立即就醫
red_flags_en: Jaundice with confusion or disorientation → suggests hepatic encephalopathy, a medical emergency
Fever with right-upper-quadrant abdominal pain and jaundice (Charcot's triad) → suggests acute cholangitis, needs urgent antibiotics and biliary drainage
Any yellowing of skin or eyes warrants prompt medical evaluation
Accompanying itchy skin, dark urine, and pale/clay-coloured stools → suggests biliary obstruction
In someone with known liver disease, worsening jaundice, increasing abdominal swelling (ascites), or new fever → seek care immediately
sources: NHS, Jaundice (https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/jaundice/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
StatPearls, Hepatic Encephalopathy (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK430869/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
StatPearls, Cholangitis (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK558946/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 黃疸辨證分型（陽黃／陰黃）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: NHS Jaundice + StatPearls Hepatic Encephalopathy + StatPearls Cholangitis (all retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 排便時或糞便中出現肉眼可見的鮮紅或暗紅色血液，西醫稱血便（hematochezia），多數來自下消化道（肛門直腸或結腸），少數為上消化道大量出血所致，需與柏油便（melena，黑便）鑑別。
records.definition_en: Visible red or maroon blood passed with or in the stool — termed hematochezia in biomedicine, most often from a lower gastrointestinal source (anorectal or colonic), occasionally from a brisk upper GI bleed. Distinguished from melena (black, tarry stool).
records.patient_words_zh: 「大便有血」「擦屁股衛生紙上有血」「馬桶裡的水變紅了」「大便顏色暗暗的」
records.patient_words_en: "There's blood in my stool", "blood on the toilet paper when I wipe", "the water in the toilet bowl turned red", "my stool looks dark"

location.why: 非部位性症狀（腸道整體）

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 鮮紅色多來自肛門直腸；暗紅色需考慮較高位結腸；黑便（柏油便）提示上消化道出血
合併腹痛、不明原因體重減輕、排便習慣改變 → 需排除大腸直腸腫瘤或發炎性腸道疾病；合併頭暈、心悸、冒冷汗 → 提示失血量大，需立即評估
已知痔瘡病史但便血持續未緩解，仍應安排大腸鏡檢查，不可逕自歸因於痔瘡
曾接受骨盆腔放射治療或手術史，本次便血需特別留意

inquiry_en.why: Bright red blood usually comes from the anorectum; darker red suggests a more proximal colonic source; black tarry stool (melena) suggests an upper GI source

Abdominal pain, unintentional weight loss, or a change in bowel habit → raises concern for colorectal malignancy or inflammatory bowel disease; dizziness, palpitations, cold sweating → suggests significant blood loss, evaluate immediately
Continued bleeding despite a known history of treated hemorrhoids should still prompt colonoscopy rather than being attributed to hemorrhoids by default
A history of pelvic radiation or pelvic surgery warrants particular attention to a new bleeding episode

differentiation_zh.variant: 便血鮮紅，肛門灼熱
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 便血鮮紅，量較多，肛門灼熱疼痛，大便黏滯不爽，舌苔黃膩

differentiation_zh.variant: 便血暗紅，先血後便
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 便血色暗淡，先血後便或血便混雜，兼神疲乏力、面色萎黃、食少便溏

differentiation_en.variant: Bright red blood with anal burning
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Bright red blood in greater amount, burning anal pain, sticky stool, yellow greasy tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Dark blood, blood before stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Dull dark blood, blood appearing before the stool or mixed in, with fatigue, sallow complexion, poor appetite, loose stool

red_flags_zh: 便血合併腹痛、不明原因體重減輕或排便習慣改變 → 需排除大腸直腸惡性腫瘤或發炎性腸道疾病
合併裡急後重、假性腹瀉或排便時疼痛
曾接受骨盆腔放射治療或手術史，本次便血
慢性出血已導致明顯貧血
合併心跳過快、血壓過低等血流動力學不穩定徵象 → 需立即輸液復甦，不可僅作常規轉診
痔瘡病史已治療但便血持續 → 應安排大腸鏡而非逕自歸因痔瘡
red_flags_en: Bleeding with abdominal pain, unintentional weight loss, or a change in bowel habit → raises concern for colorectal malignancy or inflammatory bowel disease
Accompanying tenesmus, spurious/overflow diarrhea, or painful defecation
History of pelvic radiation or pelvic surgery with new bleeding
Chronic bleeding causing significant anemia
Hemodynamic instability (e.g. tachycardia, hypotension) with rectal bleeding requires immediate resuscitation, not routine referral
Continued bleeding despite treated/resolved hemorrhoids should prompt colonoscopy rather than default attribution to hemorrhoids
sources: StatPearls, Rectal Bleeding (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK563143/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 便血辨證分型（腸道濕熱／脾不統血）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Rectal Bleeding (retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.pinyin: gang men zhong wu tuo chu
records.pinyin_toned: gāng mén zhǒng wù tuō chū
records.definition_zh: 排便時或平時肛門有腫物脫出，可能是內痔脫垂或直腸全層脫出（脫肛），西醫依脫出組織的環狀（脫肛）或放射狀（痔瘡）皺褶區分兩者。中醫統稱脫肛或痔核脫出，責之於中氣下陷。
records.definition_en: A mass protruding from the anus during defecation or at rest — either prolapsed hemorrhoidal tissue or full-thickness rectal prolapse. Biomedicine distinguishes them on exam by the fold pattern of the protruding tissue (concentric folds = rectal prolapse, radial folds = hemorrhoids). TCM attributes both to sinking of the middle qi.
records.patient_words_zh: 「大便的時候會脫出一塊肉」「肛門有東西掉出來，要用手推回去」「肛門墜脹，好像要掉出來」
records.patient_words_en: "Something comes out when I have a bowel movement", "there's a lump hanging out of my anus, I have to push it back in", "a heavy dragging feeling like something's about to fall out"

location.why: 固定於肛門部位，非多部位症狀

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 能否自行回納、需用手推回、或完全無法回納，是嚴重度分級的關鍵問題
脫出組織持續在外且無法推回 → 有嵌頓、缺血壞死風險，屬外科急症；合併黏液、糞便或血液滲漏
久蹲久坐、慢性便秘用力、產後、長期咳嗽等增加腹壓的因素
合併新發或持續便血、排便習慣改變、腹痛，需安排大腸鏡排除更近端病灶

inquiry_en.why: Whether the mass reduces spontaneously, needs manual reduction, or cannot be reduced at all is the key severity question
Tissue that stays protruded and cannot be reduced → risk of incarceration/strangulation, a surgical emergency; accompanying mucus, stool, or blood leakage
Prolonged squatting/sitting, chronic constipation with straining, postpartum status, or chronic cough increase intra-abdominal pressure
New or ongoing hematochezia, a change in bowel habit, or abdominal pain warrants colonoscopy to exclude a more proximal lesion

differentiation_zh.variant: 肛門腫物脫出，需手推回納
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肛門腫物反覆脫出，勞累或久站久蹲後加重，需用手推回，兼氣短乏力、少氣懶言

differentiation_zh.variant: 肛門腫物脫出，灼熱腫痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肛門腫物脫出，兼灼熱腫痛、大便黏滯不爽、肛門墜脹

differentiation_en.variant: Protruding mass requiring manual reduction
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Recurrent protruding anal mass, worse with exertion or prolonged standing/squatting, requires manual reduction, with shortness of breath and low energy

differentiation_en.variant: Protruding mass with burning swelling
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Protruding anal mass with burning, swelling pain, sticky stool, a heavy dragging sensation in the anus

safety_review_sources: StatPearls/NCBI Bookshelf, "Rectal Bleeding", https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK563143/, retrieved 2026-08-11 (used here for the concurrent-hematochezia colonoscopy indication, already fetched for sym.bloody_stool)
red_flags_zh: 脫出的紅色肉狀組織持續在外、無法推回 → 提示真正的直腸脫出而非單純痔瘡
脫出組織嵌頓（卡在肛門外無法手動回納）→ 有缺血壞死風險，屬外科急症
合併黏液、糞便或血液由肛門滲漏
合併持續排便不盡感或肛門疼痛、搔癢
合併新發或持續便血、排便習慣改變、腹痛 → 應安排大腸鏡排除更近端病灶，而非僅局部處置
red_flags_en: A red, fleshy mass that stays protruded and does not reduce → suggests true rectal prolapse rather than simple hemorrhoids
Incarceration — prolapsed tissue stuck outside the anus that cannot be manually reduced → risk of strangulation and tissue necrosis, a surgical emergency
Accompanying leakage of mucus, stool, or blood from the anus
Accompanying persistent sensation of incomplete evacuation, or anal pain/itching
New or continued hematochezia, change in bowel habit, or abdominal pain → should prompt colonoscopy to exclude a more proximal lesion, not just local anorectal treatment
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Rectal Prolapse (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/14615-rectal-prolapse, retrieved 2026-08-11)
StatPearls, Rectal Bleeding (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK563143/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 脫肛辨證（中氣下陷／大腸濕熱）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Rectal Prolapse (retrieved 2026-08-11); the associated-hematochezia flag cross-references the already-fetched StatPearls Rectal Bleeding page rather than an unverified PMC review

records.pinyin: zhi ti guan jie teng tong
records.pinyin_toned: zhī tǐ guān jié téng tòng
records.definition_zh: 五個或以上關節同時或先後出現疼痛，不限定於單一關節（與膝痛、肩痛等單一關節症狀不同），西醫稱多關節痛（polyarthralgia），是多種發炎性、感染性、機械性疾病的常見主訴。
records.definition_en: Pain in five or more joints, simultaneously or in sequence — distinct from single-joint complaints like knee pain or shoulder pain. Termed polyarthralgia in biomedicine, a common presenting complaint of many inflammatory, infectious, and mechanical conditions.
records.patient_words_zh: 「全身關節都痛，說不出哪一個」「這裡痛好一點，那裡又開始痛」「早上起來渾身關節僵硬又痛」
records.patient_words_en: "My joints all ache, I can't pin down just one", "one joint calms down and another starts hurting", "I wake up with my whole body's joints stiff and sore"

quality.diagnostic_note_zh: 遊走痛屬風痹 · 冷痛屬寒痹 · 重著痛屬濕痹 · 灼痛屬熱痹

inquiry_zh.why: 對稱性小關節（手指、腕）受累合併晨僵 1-3 小時，是發炎性關節炎（如類風濕）的典型模式
遊走不定屬風痹；冷痛遇寒加重屬寒痹；重著痛屬濕痹；紅腫灼痛屬熱痹
合併發熱、體重減輕、疲倦、皮疹、口腔潰瘍或腎功能異常 → 提示系統性自體免疫病；單一關節急性紅腫熱痛需優先排除感染性關節炎（化膿性關節炎為急症）
症狀提示類風濕性關節炎者，應在三週內轉診風濕科評估，及早治療對預後影響大

inquiry_en.why: Symmetric small-joint (hand/foot) involvement with 1-3 hours of morning stiffness is the classic pattern of inflammatory arthritis (e.g. rheumatoid arthritis)
Migratory pain suggests wind bi; cold pain worse with cold exposure suggests cold bi; heavy dull pain suggests damp bi; red hot burning pain suggests heat bi

Fever, weight loss, malaise, rash, mouth ulcers, or kidney involvement suggest a systemic autoimmune disease; acute single-joint redness/swelling/heat should first prompt ruling out septic arthritis, an emergency
Symptoms suggestive of rheumatoid arthritis should prompt rheumatology referral within 3 weeks — early treatment materially affects outcome

differentiation_zh.variant: 關節遊走疼痛，痛無定處
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體關節遊走性疼痛，痛無定處，兼惡風發熱，苔薄白

differentiation_zh.variant: 關節冷痛，遇寒加重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 關節冷痛，痛有定處，遇寒加重，得溫則減，關節屈伸不利

differentiation_zh.variant: 關節紅腫灼痛
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 關節紅腫灼熱疼痛，得冷則舒，可有發熱、口渴，舌紅苔黃

differentiation_en.variant: Migratory joint pain, no fixed location
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Migratory joint pain with no fixed location, with aversion to wind and fever, thin white tongue coating

differentiation_en.variant: Cold joint pain worse with cold exposure
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Cold joint pain in a fixed location, worse with cold exposure, better with warmth, restricted joint movement

differentiation_en.variant: Red, swollen, burning joint pain
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Red, swollen, burning joint pain relieved by cold, sometimes with fever and thirst, red tongue with yellow coating

red_flags_zh: 單一或多個關節突然嚴重腫脹、發熱、疼痛 → 需排除化膿性關節炎（感染性），屬急症
合併發熱、體重減輕、明顯疲倦或血管炎性皮疹、口腔潰瘍 → 提示系統性自體免疫病或感染，而非單純機械性關節痛
對稱性小關節（手、足）受累，晨僵持續 1-3 小時 → 典型發炎性關節炎模式，建議三週內轉診風濕科
合併神經功能障礙
red_flags_en: Sudden severe swelling, warmth, and pain in one or more joints → rule out septic (infectious) arthritis, an emergency
Accompanying fever, weight loss, marked fatigue, vasculitic rash, or mouth ulcers → suggests a systemic autoimmune disease or infection rather than simple mechanical joint pain
Symmetric small-joint (hand/foot) involvement with 1-3 hours of morning stiffness → classic inflammatory arthritis pattern, guidance recommends rheumatology referral within 3 weeks
Accompanying neurological impairment
sources: StatPearls, Polyarticular Arthritis (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK537170/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 痹證辨證分型（風痹／寒痹／濕痹／熱痹）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Polyarticular Arthritis (retrieved 2026-08-11); the 3-week rheumatology referral point is standard rheumatology practice guidance reflected in the same source's differential-workup framing

records.definition_zh: 肌肉組織體積與力量的減少，西醫依機轉分廢用性（通常可逆）、病理性（老化、飢餓、內分泌疾病）與神經性（神經損傷或病變，通常最嚴重、最不易恢復）三類。是體徵，需先定位機轉再找病因。
records.definition_en: Loss or thinning of muscle tissue with reduced bulk and strength. Biomedicine classifies it as physiologic (disuse, generally reversible), pathologic (aging, starvation, endocrine disease), or neurogenic (nerve injury/disease, generally the most severe and least reversible). A sign requiring the mechanism to be located before the cause is sought.
records.patient_words_zh: 「這隻手變細了，沒力氣」「肌肉一直在消瘦」「腿變細了，走路沒力」
records.patient_words_en: "This arm's gotten thinner, weaker", "my muscles keep wasting away", "my leg's gotten skinny, no strength when I walk"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 單側明顯較對側細小提示神經性萎縮，需定位病灶
神經性萎縮發展速度通常較廢用性快，且常合併麻木、刺痛或無力
合併步態或平衡問題、言語或吞嚥困難、面部無力、認知功能漸退 → 提示系統性神經退化性疾病，需儘速評估；短期內出現的疼痛性無力提示發炎性肌炎
長期臥床、石膏固定等廢用病史提供病因線索

inquiry_en.why: One limb visibly smaller than the other suggests neurogenic atrophy and warrants localising the lesion
Neurogenic atrophy tends to progress faster than disuse atrophy, and is often accompanied by numbness, tingling or weakness

Gait/balance problems, speech or swallowing difficulty, facial weakness, or progressive cognitive decline → suggest a systemic neurodegenerative cause, warrants prompt evaluation; a short history of painful weakness suggests inflammatory myositis
A history of prolonged bed rest or immobilisation (e.g. cast) provides an etiological clue for disuse

differentiation_zh.variant: 肌肉萎縮，兼肢體麻木無力
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肌肉漸進萎縮，肢體軟弱無力，兼麻木、面色萎黃、神疲乏力

differentiation_zh.variant: 肌肉萎縮，兼腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肌肉萎縮日久，兼腰膝痠軟、步履不穩、精神委靡，多見於久病或年長者

differentiation_en.variant: Muscle atrophy with limb numbness and weakness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Progressive muscle atrophy with limb weakness, numbness, sallow complexion, fatigue

differentiation_en.variant: Muscle atrophy with weak low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Long-standing muscle atrophy with weak aching low back and knees, unsteady gait, low spirits, mainly in chronic illness or older patients

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, "Muscle atrophy", https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003188.htm — search-summary sourced, not independently re-fetched in full this session, flagged for manual verification
red_flags_zh: 萎縮發展速度較快，合併患側肢體麻木、刺痛或無力 → 提示神經性病因，需儘速評估
一側肢體明顯較對側細小（不對稱萎縮）
合併步態或平衡問題、言語或吞嚥困難、臉部無力，或漸進性認知功能減退 → 提示系統性神經退化性疾病
短期內（數週至數月）出現的疼痛性無力，成年後新發 → 提示發炎性肌炎，而非單純廢用性萎縮
red_flags_en: Rapid-onset atrophy with numbness, tingling, or weakness in the affected limb → suggests a neurogenic cause, warrants prompt evaluation
One limb visibly smaller than the other (asymmetric wasting)
Concurrent gait/balance problems, speech or swallowing difficulty, facial weakness, or progressive cognitive decline → suggests a systemic neurodegenerative cause
A short history (weeks to months) of painful weakness developing in adulthood → suggests inflammatory myositis rather than simple disuse atrophy
sources: Cleveland Clinic, Muscle Atrophy (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/22310-muscle-atrophy, retrieved 2026-08-11)
MedlinePlus, Muscle atrophy — search-summary sourced, needs manual verification (2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 痿證辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: Cleveland Clinic Muscle Atrophy (directly fetched, 2026-08-11); MedlinePlus supplementary detail flagged as search-summary only

records.pinyin: bu neng sui yi yun dong
records.pinyin_toned: bù néng suí yì yùn dòng
records.definition_zh: 自主肌肉活動喪失，伴肌張力降低（鬆軟）與反射減弱或消失，西醫稱鬆弛性麻痺（flaccid paralysis），源於下運動神經元病變，與痙攣性麻痺（上運動神經元病變，肌張力增高、反射亢進）相對。
records.definition_en: Loss of voluntary muscle movement with decreased or absent muscle tone (hypotonia) and decreased or absent reflexes — termed flaccid paralysis in biomedicine, arising from a lower-motor-neuron lesion, as opposed to spastic paralysis (upper-motor-neuron lesion with increased tone and hyperreflexia).
records.patient_words_zh: 「這隻手完全動不了，軟軟的」「腿沒力氣抬不起來」「肢體軟弱無力，不聽使喚」
records.patient_words_en: "This arm just won't move, it's completely limp", "my leg has no strength, I can't lift it", "my limb feels weak and floppy, it won't do what I tell it"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 數小時至數日內快速進展的無力，尤其兒童，須視為需通報的緊急狀況
合併呼吸肌無力（呼吸急促、費力）→ 可能需插管，屬最緊急的紅旗；合併顱神經受累（吞嚥、言語、眼球運動障礙）提示氣道風險
受累範圍（單肢、雙側、上升性）協助定位病灶與判斷急迫性
若同時出現肌張力增高、反射亢進，需重新考慮是否為痙攣性而非鬆弛性病變

inquiry_en.why: Weakness progressing rapidly over hours to days, especially in a child, must be treated as a reportable emergency
Respiratory muscle weakness (rapid, laboured breathing) → may need intubation, the most urgent red flag; cranial nerve involvement (swallowing, speech, eye movement) signals airway risk
The extent of involvement (single limb, bilateral, ascending) helps localise the lesion and gauge urgency
If increased tone or hyperreflexia is also present, reconsider whether this is actually a spastic rather than flaccid process

differentiation_zh.variant: 肢體軟弱不能隨意運動，兼皮膚枯槁
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 肢體軟弱，不能隨意運動，皮膚枯槁不澤，氣短懶言，食少便溏

differentiation_zh.variant: 下肢軟弱突發，兼腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 下肢痿軟無力，不能站立行走，兼腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴

differentiation_en.variant: Flaccid limb weakness with withered skin
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Flaccid limb weakness, loss of voluntary movement, dry withered skin, shortness of breath, poor appetite, loose stool

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden lower-limb weakness with weak low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Flaccid weakness of the lower limbs, unable to stand or walk, with weak aching low back and knees, dizziness and tinnitus

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus, "Paralysis", https://medlineplus.gov/paralysis.html, retrieved 2026-08-11 — defines regional paralysis patterns but does not itself distinguish flaccid vs. spastic or list red flags; noted explicitly rather than over-extending its content
red_flags_zh: 呼吸肌無力導致呼吸功能不足 → 可能需插管與呼吸器支持，是最緊急的紅旗
數小時至數日內快速進展的無力
突發性肢體無力或癱瘓，尤其兒童 → 需視為需早期辨識與通報的急性鬆弛性脊髓炎
合併顱神經受累——眼球運動障礙、面部麻痺或延髓（吞嚥／言語）肌肉無力 → 提示氣道風險
合併肌張力增高、反射亢進 → 應重新考慮病灶定位，而非單純鬆弛性病變
red_flags_en: Respiratory muscle weakness causing respiratory insufficiency → may require intubation and ventilatory support, the most urgent red flag
Weakness progressing rapidly over hours to days
Sudden-onset limb weakness or paralysis, especially in a child → treat as acute flaccid myelitis, early recognition and reporting are critical
Cranial nerve involvement — eye movement abnormality, facial palsy, or bulbar (swallowing/speech) muscle weakness → signals airway risk
Presence of increased tone or hyperreflexia → should prompt reconsidering the lesion localisation rather than assuming a pure flaccid process
sources: StatPearls, Acute Flaccid Myelitis (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK606127/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
MedlinePlus, Paralysis (https://medlineplus.gov/paralysis.html, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 痿證辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Acute Flaccid Myelitis (retrieved 2026-08-11); MedlinePlus Paralysis used only for the general definition, not stretched beyond its actual content

records.definition_zh: 皮膚失去正常彈性與光澤，捏起後緩慢回彈（皮膚張力降低），常伴黏膜乾燥，是脫水或嚴重營養不良的重要體徵。中醫稱肌膚甲錯或皮膚枯槁，多責之於精血虧虛、津液不足。
records.definition_en: Skin that has lost its normal elasticity and moisture — "tenting" or slow return to shape after being pinched (reduced skin turgor), often with dry mucous membranes. An important bedside sign of dehydration or, in chronic form, malnutrition. Biomedicine decomposes this into skin turgor (a dehydration-severity finding) rather than treating it as one unified named entity.
records.patient_words_zh: 「皮膚很乾，摸起來粗粗的」「皮膚沒有彈性，捏起來很久才彈回去」「皮膚乾到會脫屑」
records.patient_words_en: "My skin's really dry, it feels rough", "my skin's lost its bounce, it takes a while to spring back when pinched", "my skin's so dry it's flaking"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

inquiry_zh.why: 合併口乾黏膜乾燥提示中重度脫水；合併血壓下降、心跳加快（姿勢性低血壓）提示血容量不足；合併意識改變、癲癇提示嚴重電解質失衡
腹瀉、嘔吐、大量出汗、進食進水不足等病史提供脫水病因線索；長期病重、消瘦提示營養不良
急性快速惡化（如伴隨少尿、意識改變）需立即處理，不可僅囑咐補水觀察

inquiry_en.why: Dry mucous membranes suggest moderate-to-severe dehydration; falling blood pressure with rising heart rate (orthostatic hypotension) suggests significant volume depletion; altered consciousness or seizures suggest a dangerous electrolyte disturbance
A history of diarrhea, vomiting, heavy sweating, or poor oral intake provides an etiological clue for dehydration; chronic severe illness with wasting suggests malnutrition
Rapid deterioration (e.g. with oliguria or altered consciousness) needs immediate management, not just advice to rehydrate and observe

differentiation_zh.variant: 皮膚枯槁，兼形體消瘦
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 皮膚枯槁失潤，兼形體消瘦、面色萎黃、神疲乏力，多屬久病氣血兩虛

differentiation_zh.variant: 皮膚枯槁，兼口燥咽乾
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 皮膚乾枯，兼口燥咽乾、五心煩熱、形體消瘦，舌紅少津

differentiation_en.variant: Withered skin with wasting
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Withered, lusterless skin with wasting, sallow complexion, fatigue — typically chronic qi-and-blood deficiency

differentiation_en.variant: Withered skin with dry mouth and throat
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Withered dry skin with dry mouth and throat, five-center heat, wasting, red tongue with scant fluid

safety_review_sources: StatPearls/NCBI Bookshelf, "Adult Dehydration", https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK555956/, retrieved 2026-08-11 — note: biomedicine formalises this finding as "skin turgor" within dehydration grading rather than as a single named "withered skin" entity; flagged rather than overstating a unified biomedical term
red_flags_zh: 皮膚張力降低合併黏膜乾燥 → 提示中重度脫水
極度低血壓合併皮膚濕冷、灌流不良 → 提示低血容性休克，屬急症
合併心跳過快與姿勢性低血壓，提示明顯血容量不足
合併意識混亂、嗜睡或昏迷，尤其合併高血鈉 → 提示危險的電解質失衡
脫水情境下出現癲癇發作 → 提示嚴重鈉／電解質失衡
合併少尿／無尿或急性腎損傷徵象
red_flags_en: Decreased skin turgor with dry mucous membranes → suggests moderate-to-severe dehydration
Profound hypotension with cool, moist, poorly perfused skin → suggests hypovolemic shock, an emergency
Tachycardia with orthostatic hypotension, indicating significant volume depletion
Confusion, lethargy, or coma — especially with hypernatremia → represents a dangerous electrolyte disturbance
Seizures in the setting of dehydration signal a critical sodium/electrolyte imbalance
Oliguria/anuria or signs of acute kidney injury
sources: StatPearls, Adult Dehydration (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK555956/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 津液虧虛／精血不足相關肌膚甲錯內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: StatPearls Adult Dehydration (retrieved 2026-08-11); biomedical entity noted as partial/decomposed rather than unified

records.definition_zh: 聽覺感知能力下降，可為單側或雙側、輕度至重度，西醫依機轉分傳導性（外中耳）、感音神經性（內耳／聽神經）與混合性。中醫稱耳聾或聽力減退，責之於腎開竅於耳。
records.definition_en: A reduction in the ability to perceive sound, ranging from mild to profound, unilateral or bilateral. Biomedicine classifies it by mechanism as conductive (outer/middle ear), sensorineural (inner ear/auditory nerve), or mixed. TCM attributes hearing to the Kidney's opening into the ear.
records.patient_words_zh: 「聽不太清楚，要別人講大聲一點」「一邊耳朵聽起來悶悶的」「電視要開很大聲才聽得到」
records.patient_words_en: "I can't hear well, people have to speak up", "one ear sounds muffled", "I need the TV really loud to hear it"

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

severity.why: 實例值（如分貝數），屬病例層

inquiry_zh.why: 突發性或快速進行的聽力減退是最緊急的紅旗，需在 72 小時內轉診耳鼻喉科以爭取恢復機會
合併耳痛、分泌物或出血、單側或搏動性耳鳴（提示血管性病灶）、反覆或慢性頭暈平衡問題 → 需轉診評估
中耳炎病史、噪音暴露史、家族聽力損失史、耳毒性藥物使用史、頭部外傷史等提供病因線索
雙耳不對稱程度大（>15 分貝差）或言語辨識能力差，需要進一步聽力學檢查

inquiry_en.why: Sudden or rapidly progressive hearing loss is the single most urgent red flag — otolaryngology evaluation within 72 hours is needed to preserve the chance of recovery
Ear pain, discharge or bleeding; unilateral or pulsatile tinnitus (raising concern for a vascular lesion); recurrent or chronic dizziness/balance problems → warrant referral
A history of ear infection, noise exposure, family history of hearing loss, ototoxic medication use, or head trauma provides etiological clues
Marked asymmetry between ears (>15 dB difference) or poor speech discrimination warrants further audiological testing

differentiation_zh.variant: 耳聾突發，兼耳鳴眩暈
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 耳聾突然發生，兼耳鳴如潮、眩暈、面紅目赤、急躁易怒

differentiation_zh.variant: 聽力漸減，兼腰膝痠軟
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 聽力漸進減退，兼耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、頭暈健忘，多見於年長者或久病

differentiation_en.variant: Sudden hearing loss with tinnitus and dizziness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Sudden-onset hearing loss with tide-like tinnitus, dizziness, flushed face and red eyes, irritability

differentiation_en.variant: Gradual hearing loss with weak low back and knees
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Gradually progressive hearing loss with tinnitus, weak aching low back and knees, dizziness and forgetfulness, mainly in older patients or chronic illness

safety_review_sources: American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (AAO-HNS), "Position Statement: Red Flags – Warning of Ear Disease", https://www.entnet.org/resource/position-statement-red-flags-warning-of-ear-disease/, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 突發或快速進行的聽力減退 → 感音神經性聽力損失需在症狀出現 72 小時內轉診耳鼻喉科評估，以爭取恢復機會
合併耳痛、分泌物或出血，或耳道內可見異物／血液／膿
單側或搏動性耳鳴（搏動性尤其需留意血管性病灶）
合併急性、慢性或反覆性頭暈／平衡問題
有中耳炎、噪音暴露、家族聽力損失史、結核、梅毒、HIV、梅尼爾氏病、自體免疫病、耳毒性藥物使用、耳硬化症、神經纖維瘤病、柏哲德氏病或頭部外傷史
雙耳聽力差異明顯（純音平均 >15 分貝）或言語辨識能力差
red_flags_en: Sudden or rapidly progressive hearing loss → sudden sensorineural hearing loss needs otolaryngology evaluation within 72 hours of onset to preserve the chance of recovery
Accompanying ear pain, discharge, or bleeding, or visible blood/pus/foreign body in the canal
Unilateral or pulsatile tinnitus (pulsatile in particular raises concern for a vascular lesion)
Accompanying acute, chronic, or recurrent dizziness/balance problems

History of ear infection, significant noise exposure, family history of hearing loss, TB, syphilis, HIV, Ménière's disease, autoimmune disease, ototoxic medication use, otosclerosis, neurofibromatosis, Paget's disease of bone, or head/ear trauma
Significant asymmetry between ears (>15 dB pure-tone average difference) or poor speech discrimination
sources: AAO-HNS, Position Statement: Red Flags – Warning of Ear Disease (https://www.entnet.org/resource/position-statement-red-flags-warning-of-ear-disease/, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 耳聾／耳鳴辨證內容

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: AAO-HNS Red Flags position statement (retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_zh: 自主動作的速度、幅度或流暢度下降，重複動作時逐漸變小變慢，西醫視其為帕金森氏症的核心必要徵象（需併有靜止性震顫或肌強直方可臨床診斷）。是體徵而非診斷，本身即是需要神經科評估的指標。
records.definition_en: Slowness of voluntary movement, with reduced amplitude and speed of repetitive movements that progressively fatigue or hesitate. Biomedicine treats bradykinesia as the cardinal, obligatory diagnostic feature of Parkinson's disease (alongside tremor and/or rigidity). A sign rather than a diagnosis — its presence is itself an indicator warranting neurological evaluation.
records.patient_words_zh: 「動作變慢了，扣扣子要花好久」「走路小碎步，起步很困難」「表情變少了，家人說我像面具臉」
records.patient_words_en: "My movements have slowed down, buttoning my shirt takes forever", "I shuffle when I walk, it's hard to get started", "my expression's gotten flatter, my family says I look like I'm wearing a mask"

location.why: 全身性運動症狀，非局部部位

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

laterality.diagnostic_note_zh: 帕金森氏症典型從單側開始

inquiry_zh.why: 合併靜止性震顫或肌強直 → 符合帕金森氏症核心診斷條件；合併面部表情減少、眨眼減少、手臂擺動減少為典型表現
扣鈕扣、切食物、刷牙等精細動作困難是常見的功能性主訴
本卡未找到針對動作遲緩本身的獨立紅旗清單（不同於其他症狀有明確急症升級標準）——動作遲緩本身即是啟動神經科評估的指標，而非等待其他警訊出現

inquiry_en.why: With resting tremor or rigidity → meets the core diagnostic criteria for Parkinson's disease; reduced facial expression, reduced blinking, and reduced arm swing are typical
Difficulty with fine motor tasks — buttoning, cutting food, brushing teeth — is a common functional complaint

No dedicated escalation-style red-flag list specific to bradykinesia itself was found (unlike other symptoms with clear emergency criteria) — the presence of bradykinesia is itself the trigger for neurological workup, rather than something to wait on further warning signs for

differentiation_zh.variant: 動作遲緩，兼靜止性震顫、肌強直
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 動作遲緩，起步困難，兼靜止性震顫、肌肉強直、表情呆滯，緩慢進行

differentiation_zh.variant: 動作遲緩，兼神疲懶言
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 動作遲緩乏力，兼神疲懶言、氣短、不耐勞作，無明顯震顫強直

differentiation_en.variant: Bradykinesia with resting tremor and rigidity
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Slowed movement with difficulty initiating, resting tremor, muscle rigidity, blank facial expression, slowly progressive

differentiation_en.variant: Bradykinesia with low spirits and reluctance to speak
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Slowed, weak movement with low spirits, reluctance to speak, shortness of breath, poor exertional tolerance, without notable tremor or rigidity

safety_review_sources: Parkinson's Foundation, "Bradykinesia (Slowness of Movement)", https://www.parkinson.org/understanding-parkinsons/movement-symptoms/bradykinesia, retrieved 2026-08-11 — this source frames bradykinesia as a diagnostic hallmark rather than providing an accompanying-feature escalation list; no dedicated red-flag list found this session, so this card references the generic neurologic_red_flags safety_flag rather than inventing symptom-specific red flags without a source
sources: Parkinson's Foundation, Bradykinesia (https://www.parkinson.org/understanding-parkinsons/movement-symptoms/bradykinesia, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 顫證辨證內容

field_sources.safety_review_sources: Parkinson's Foundation source frames bradykinesia as diagnostic hallmark, not an escalation-list symptom; honestly using shared_flags_linked -> neurologic_red_flags rather than fabricating a red-flag list the source does not provide

records.definition_zh: 在未刻意改變飲食或活動量的情況下，體重與形體逐漸明顯減輕。西醫稱非刻意性體重減輕（unintentional weight loss），臨床警戒線為 6-12 個月內減少原體重 5% 以上或 4.5 公斤以上，65 歲以上者尤需重視。是主訴，不等於任何單一診斷。
records.definition_en: A noticeable, unintended loss of body weight and flesh without a deliberate change in diet or activity. Biomedicine terms this unintentional weight loss, clinically flagged at ≥5% of body weight or ≥4.5 kg (10 lb) over 6-12 months, especially concerning in adults over 65. A presenting complaint, not itself a diagnosis.
records.patient_words_zh: 「最近瘦了一大圈，衣服都變鬆了」「沒有刻意減肥，體重一直掉」「人一直瘦下去，家人都說我變小了」
records.patient_words_en: "I've lost a lot of weight recently, my clothes are loose", "I haven't been trying to lose weight but it keeps dropping", "I keep getting thinner, my family says I've shrunk"

location.why: 全身性表現，非局部部位

quality.why: 非疼痛性質症狀

severity.why: 實例值（體重數字、下降百分比），屬病例層

inquiry_zh.why: 合併持續發熱或夜間盜汗、新發或加重疼痛、可觸及腫塊 → 需儘速檢查；合併吞嚥困難或疼痛、明顯疲倦、淋巴結腫大
食慾、進食量、消化吸收狀況、情緒與睡眠變化提供病因線索
65 歲以上出現非刻意性體重減輕，本身即提高嚴重疾病的機率，需優先評估
合併血便或吐血；合併明顯情緒、認知或食慾改變

inquiry_en.why: Persistent fever or drenching night sweats, new/worsening pain, a palpable mass → needs prompt workup; difficulty or pain swallowing, marked fatigue, swollen lymph nodes
Appetite, intake volume, digestion/absorption, and mood/sleep changes provide etiological clues
Unintentional weight loss in someone over 65 itself raises the probability of serious disease and warrants priority evaluation
Blood in stool or vomit; a marked change in mood, cognition, or appetite

differentiation_zh.variant: 形體消瘦，兼食少便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 形體日漸消瘦，兼食少納呆、腹脹便溏、神疲乏力、面色萎黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 形體消瘦，兼多食易饑、口渴
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 形體消瘦，反而多食易饑，兼口渴喜飲、大便秘結、舌紅苔黃

differentiation_zh.variant: 形體消瘦，兼潮熱盜汗
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 形體日漸消瘦，兼潮熱盜汗、五心煩熱、口燥咽乾，舌紅少苔

differentiation_en.variant: Wasting with poor appetite and loose stool
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Progressive wasting with poor appetite, abdominal distension, loose stool, fatigue, sallow complexion

differentiation_en.variant: Wasting with excessive hunger and thirst
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Wasting despite excessive hunger and eating, marked thirst, constipation, red tongue with yellow coating

differentiation_en.variant: Wasting with tidal fever and night sweats
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Progressive wasting with tidal fever and night sweats, five-center heat, dry mouth and throat, red tongue with scant coating

safety_review_sources: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia, "Weight loss - unintentional", https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003107.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11
red_flags_zh: 非刻意性體重減輕合併持續發熱或夜間盜汗
合併新發或逐漸加重的疼痛，或可觸及的腫塊／腫塊感
合併血便、吐血，或持續吞嚥困難／吞嚥疼痛
合併嚴重或加重的疲倦，或淋巴結腫大
65 歲以上出現非刻意性體重減輕（年齡本身即提高重症機率）
合併明顯的情緒、認知或食慾改變
red_flags_en: Unintentional weight loss with persistent fever or drenching night sweats
Accompanying new/worsening pain, or a palpable mass/lump
Blood in stool or vomit, or persistent difficulty/pain swallowing
Severe or worsening fatigue, or swollen lymph nodes
Unintentional weight loss in someone over 65 (age itself raises the probability of serious disease)
A marked, unexplained change in mood, cognition, or appetite
sources: MedlinePlus, Weight loss - unintentional (https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003107.htm, retrieved 2026-08-11)
Cleveland Clinic, Unexplained Weight Loss (https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/symptoms/unexplained-weight-loss, retrieved 2026-08-11)
中醫內科學 虛勞辨證分型（脾氣虛／胃火／陰虛）

field_sources.red_flags_zh/en: MedlinePlus Weight loss - unintentional + Cleveland Clinic Unexplained Weight Loss (both retrieved 2026-08-11)

records.definition_en: A persistent or recurrent subjective sense of sadness, dejection and lack of drive, usually with reduced interest or pleasure, lower energy, and diminished self-regard. It is a presenting complaint, not a diagnosis — the same low mood appears under dozens of biomedical labels (major depressive disorder, dysthymia, adjustment disorder, postpartum depression, hypothyroidism, menopausal syndrome, medication side effects) and under TCM disease categories such as 鬱證 (depression-type disorder), 臟躁 (organ restlessness) and 梅核氣 (plum-pit qi), so this card records what to ask, what it points toward, and when to refer — not a conclusion.
records.definition_zh: 情緒持續或反覆出現的低落、憂傷、提不起勁的主觀感受，常伴隨興趣與愉悅感減退、精力下降、自我評價降低。它是主訴，不是診斷——同一個「情緒低落」可以出現在重度憂鬱症、輕鬱症、適應障礙、產後憂鬱、甲狀腺功能低下、更年期綜合症、藥物副作用等數十個西醫病名之下，中醫則多歸屬鬱證、臟躁、梅核氣等病機範疇，所以卡片記錄的是「該問什麼、指向哪裡、何時該轉診」，不是結論。

differentiation_en.variant: Distending oppression worse with emotional swings, frequent sighing
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood triggered by unresolved emotional stress, clearly worse with emotional fluctuation, with distending oppression or wandering pain in the chest and hypochondrium (or breasts), frequent sighing, a sensation of something stuck in the throat, slightly eased premenstrually or after emotional release, wiry pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Low mood with irritability, bitter taste and constipation
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood together with marked irritability, burning distending pain in the chest and hypochondrium, headache with red eyes, bitter taste and dry mouth, constipation with dark urine, red tongue with yellow coating, wiry rapid pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Fatigue and sallow complexion, poor appetite and loose stools
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood that has lingered for a long time, with marked listlessness, palpitations and insomnia, forgetfulness with vivid dreams, poor appetite and fatigue, sallow complexion — often after excessive overthinking, illness or childbirth, pale tongue with thin coating

differentiation_en.variant: Tearfulness, palpitations and forgetfulness, pale complexion
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood with easy tearfulness and being easily moved, palpitations, insomnia with dreaming, forgetfulness and dizziness, pale complexion without lustre, pale tongue and thin pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Blunted apathy with a lump-in-throat sensation, chest oppression and head heaviness
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood with blunted, apathetic affect, a sensation of something stuck in the throat that can neither be coughed up nor swallowed down, fullness and distension in the chest and epigastrium, heavy head and body, white greasy coating, wiry slippery pulse

differentiation_en.variant: Timidity and easy fright, fearful of being alone
differentiation_en.distinguishing: Low mood together with being easily startled and fearful, indecisiveness, timidity about being alone, disturbed sleep with frequent waking, shortness of breath with spontaneous sweating, the heart races with minimal provocation, pale tongue with thin coating

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落隨情志波動加重，胸脅脹悶善太息
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落因情志不遂誘發，隨情緒波動明顯加重，兼胸脅或乳房脹悶竄痛、喜歎息、咽中如有物梗，經前或情緒紓解後稍減，脈弦

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落夾煩躁易怒，口苦目赤便秘
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落與急躁易怒並見，胸脅脹痛灼熱，頭痛目赤、口苦咽乾，便秘尿黃，舌紅苔黃，脈弦數

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落神疲乏力，面色萎黃食少便溏
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落纏綿日久，精神萎靡不振，兼心悸失眠、多夢健忘、食少倦怠、面色萎黃，多見於思慮過度或病後、產後，舌淡苔薄

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落悲傷欲哭，心悸健忘面色淡白
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落兼悲傷欲哭、觸景易感，心悸怔忡、失眠多夢、健忘眩暈，面色淡白無華，舌淡脈細

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落淡漠遲鈍，咽中如物梗胸悶頭重
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落兼反應淡漠遲鈍，咽中如有異物梗阻、咯之不出嚥之不下，胸脅脘悶脹滿，頭重身困，苔白膩，脈弦滑

differentiation_zh.variant: 情緒低落善恐易驚，膽怯不敢獨處
differentiation_zh.distinguishing: 情緒低落兼遇事善驚易恐、猶豫不決、膽怯不敢獨處，少寐多夢、氣短自汗，稍受驚嚇即心悸不寧，舌淡苔薄

inquiry_en.why: A clear precipitating event (bereavement, job loss, relationship breakdown, childbirth, a serious diagnosis), medication history or medical illness determines whether the mood is primarily psychosocial, organic, or reflects a TCM emotion-based mechanism

A diurnal pattern of worse-in-the-morning, better-by-evening is typical of a major depressive episode; marked premenstrual worsening implicates the Chong/Ren and Liver Qi stagnation; a seasonal pattern should also be recorded, as it shapes the treatment direction

Dejection with chest and hypochondriac fullness, irritability with a bitter taste, tearfulness with palpitations, and blunted apathy with head heaviness point to four different mechanisms — the highest-yield question for pattern differentiation
Changes in sleep, appetite, weight, energy and libido are core diagnostic criteria for a depressive episode, and also the basis for TCM organ (Heart/Spleen/Liver/Kidney) differentiation
Reduced concentration, self-blame, loss of interest and pleasure, and the presence or absence of self-harm or suicidal ideation are the key question deciding red-flag status and referral priority

Improvement with exercise, talking things through or social contact suggests a treatable qi-stagnation pattern; worsening with isolation or exertion suggests deficiency — this decides whether home-based management can be tried first or referral is needed sooner

A first versus recurrent episode, any history of mania or hypomania, and any thyroid or other chronic illness history determine the treatment direction and rule out bipolar disorder or an organic cause

inquiry_zh.why: 是否有明確誘發事件（喪親、失業、關係破裂、產後、重大疾病診斷）、藥物或內科疾病史，決定屬心因性、器質性或中醫情志致病
晨重夜輕的日夜節律典型見於重度憂鬱發作；經前明顯加重提示衝任與肝鬱；季節性發作需一併記錄，決定治療方向
悶悶不樂而胸脅脹悶、煩躁易怒而口苦、悲傷欲哭而心悸、淡漠遲鈍而頭重胸悶，四種性質分屬不同病機，是本症最有辨證重量的一問
睡眠、食慾、體重、精力、性慾的改變是憂鬱發作的核心診斷條件，也是中醫辨臟腑虛實（心、脾、肝、腎）的依據
專注力下降、自責感、興趣與愉悅感喪失，以及有無自傷或自殺意念，是紅旗判斷與是否需優先轉診的關鍵一問
運動、傾訴、社交後是否減輕屬氣鬱可疏；獨處、勞累後加重屬虛；決定可否先以居家調理觀察或需及早轉診
首次發作或反覆發作、有無躁狂／輕躁狂發作史、有無甲狀腺或其他慢性病史，決定治療方向並排除雙相情感障礙或器質性病因

records.patient_words_en: "I feel so heavy, I don't want to do anything", "I can't feel happy about anything", "I have no drive left, nothing feels worth doing", "there's an emptiness inside I can't explain", "I burst into tears for no reason", "mornings are the worst, I feel a bit better by evening", "I feel worthless, like a burden to everyone"
records.patient_words_zh: 「心情很悶，什麼都不想做」「開心不起來」「整個人提不起勁，做什麼都沒意思」「心裡空空的，說不出哪裡不舒服」「動不動就想哭」「早上起床特別難受，到了晚上反而好一點」「覺得自己很沒用、拖累別人」
red_flags_en: Clear thoughts, plans or intent of self-harm or suicide, or a past suicide attempt → immediate urgent psychiatric evaluation, not routine emotional support or acupuncture/TCM management alone
Low mood with hallucinations, delusions or marked loss of touch with reality → suggests a major depressive episode with psychotic features, requiring emergency psychiatric intervention
New-onset low mood within 4 weeks postpartum with confused thinking or thoughts of harming self or the infant → rule out postpartum psychosis, a medical emergency

A history of mania or hypomania (abnormally elevated mood, markedly reduced need for sleep with retained energy, impulsive behaviour with impaired judgment) → suggests bipolar disorder; specialist evaluation is needed before starting an antidepressant, which can precipitate a manic switch

Onset of low mood after starting steroids, interferon, isotretinoin, certain antihypertensives (e.g. propranolol), or hormonal contraception → consider medication-induced mood disturbance and review the drug history
Low mood with palpitations, heat or cold intolerance, marked unintentional weight change, or constipation → medical evaluation to rule out thyroid dysfunction or another organic cause
New-onset low mood in an older adult with marked cognitive decline or disorientation → differentiate depression-related pseudodementia from an organic dementia, and refer for evaluation
red_flags_zh: 出現明確自傷或自殺意念、計畫，或曾有自殺未遂史 → 立即精神科緊急評估，不可僅以一般情緒疏導或針灸／中醫方式處理
情緒低落合併幻覺、妄想或明顯脫離現實的思考 → 提示伴精神病性特徵的重度憂鬱，需精神科緊急介入
產後 4 週內新發情緒低落，合併思路混亂、傷害自己或嬰兒的念頭 → 排除產後精神病，屬醫療急症
曾有躁狂或輕躁狂發作史（情緒異常高昂、睡眠需求明顯減少仍精力旺盛、判斷力受損的衝動行為）→ 疑似雙相情感障礙，使用抗憂鬱藥物前須先由專科評估，以免誘發躁狂轉相
近期新使用類固醇、干擾素、異維 A 酸（isotretinoin）、某些降壓藥（如 propranolol）或荷爾蒙避孕藥後出現情緒低落 → 考慮藥物誘發性情緒障礙，需回顧用藥史
合併心悸、怕熱或怕冷、體重明顯驟降或驟升、便秘等代謝症狀 → 需醫療評估排除甲狀腺功能異常等器質性病因
老年人新發情緒低落合併認知功能明顯下降、定向力障礙 → 需鑑別假性失智（憂鬱所致認知障礙）與器質性失智，轉診評估
